(अत्), n. abundance of grain (Ved.). —यव-मध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, having the middle like a barely-corn, i. e. stout or broad in the centre and thin or tapering at the ends; (अस्), m. a kind of drum; (आ), f. a kind of metre; (अम्), n. a kind of penance (= यव-मध्यम, q. v.); a particular measure of length. —यव-मध्यम, अम्, n. a kind of lunar penance, (see चान्द्रायण।) —यव-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of barley, made of barley. —यव-मात्र, अस्, ई, अम्, measuring a barley-corn, as large as a grain of barley. —यव-मुष्टि, इस्, m. f. a handful of barley. —यव-लास, अस्, m. nitre, saltpetre. —यव-वक्त्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having a head or point like a grain of barley. —यव-शिरस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, having a head shaped like a grain of barley, (see यव-ग्रीव।) —यव-शूक or यव-शूक-ज, अस्, m. = यव-क्षार, a kind of alkaline salt prepared from the ashes of burnt barley-straw. —यव-सुर, अम्, n. malt-liquor, an intoxicating drink prepared from barley, beer. —यवाकार (°व-आक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, barley-shaped, shaped like a barley-corn. —यवाग्र-ज (°व-अग्°), अस्, m. = यव-क्षार, N. of a plant, Ptychotis Ajowan (= य-वानी). —यवाग्रयण (°व-आग्°), अम्, n. the first-lings or first-fruits of barley. —यवाङ्कुर (°व-अङ्°), अस्, m. a shoot or blade of barley. —यवाचित (°व-आच्°), अस्, आ, अम्, laden with barley. —यवाद् (°व-अद्), त्, त्, त्, eating barley, living on barley. —य-वान्न (°व-अन्°), अम्, n. barley-food, boiled barley. —यवापत्य (°व-अप्°), अम्, n. = यव-क्षार। —यवाम्ल-ज (°व-अम्°), अम्, n. sour barley-gruel. —यवाशिर् (°व-आश्°), ईर्, ईर्, ईर्, mixed or malted with barley. —यवाहार (°व-आह्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having barley for food, living on barley. —य-वाह्व (°व-आह्°), अस्, m. = यव-क्षार. —यवोत्-थ (°व-उत्°), अम्, n. = यवाम्ल-ज. —यवोदर (°व-उद्°), अम्, n. the body or thick part of a grain of barley used as a measure of length. —यवोर्वरा (°व-उर्°), f., Ved. a filed sown with barley, barley-field.
यव्य: 1. यव्य, अस्, m. (for 2. see col. 3), a month (as containing a यव, see above).

2. यव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. यव्य see col. 2), suitable or fit for barley; sown with or consisting of barley; (अस्), m., Ved. a stock of barley or fruit; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a family of Ṛṣis; (अम्), n. a field of barley; (Ved.) epithet of certain Homa-mantras; (आ), f., Ved. a river, stream (in Ṛg-veda VIII. 98, 8).
यवयावन्: यवयावन्, आ, m., Ved. one who keeps off or averts.
यवक: यवक, अस्, m. barley; = यव-प्रकार, a sort of barley.
यवक्य: यवक्य, अस्, आ, अम्, producing barley, sown with barley, fit for barley.
यवक्षा: यवक्षा, f., N. of a river.
यवयु: यवयु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. desiring barley or corn, (Sāy. = यवेच्छु।)
यवस: यवस, अम्, n. (according to some also अस्, m.), grass, fodder, food, pasturage, pasture, meadow grass. —यवस-प्रथम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. beginning with or depending on good pasturage, well-nurtured; (according to Mahī-dhara on Vājasaneyi-s. XXI. 43. first or best of all kinds of food.) —यवसाद् (°स-अद्), त्, त्, त्, Ved. eating or consuming grass, grazing, pasturing, feeding. —यवसान्नोदकेन्धन (°स-अन्न-उद्°, °क-इन्°), अम्, n. grass, corn, water, and fuel. —यवसोदक (°स-उद्°), ए, n. du. grass and water.
यवागू: यवागू, ऊस्, f. (in Uṇādi-s. III. 81. said to come fr. rt. 2. यु), sour gruel, rice-gruel (made from rice boiled with water and said to be composed of six measures of water to one of rice); any thin decoction of other kinds of grain, &c., (according to some, a decoction in which four measures of grain are steeped in sixty-four measures of water and the whole boiled down to half the original quantity.) —यवागू-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of Yavāgū.
यवानी: यवानी, f. a kind of bad barley; Ptychotis Ajowan.
यवास: यवास, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. 2. यु), = यास, Alhagi Maurorum; a species of Khadira; (आ), f. a kind of grass (= गुण्डासिनी). —यवास-शर्करा, f. a kind of sugar made from Yavāsa.
यवासिनी: यवासिनी, f. a district abounding in Yavāsa.
यविक: यविक or यविल, अस्, आ, अम्, having or producing barley.
यविन्: यविन्, ई, इनी, इ, = यविक above.
यव्यावती: यव्या-वती, f., Ved., N. of a river (in Ṛg-veda VI. 27, 6, identified by Sāy. with Hariyūpīyā, which he describes as the N. of a river or of a city); N. of a district.
यवगण्ड: यवगण्ड यवगण्ड, अस्, m. = युव-गण्ड, a kind of eruption on the face.
यवन: यवन यवन, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. or 2. यु, or connected with rt. जु = 1. जू), one who keeps back; one who mixes, &c., see Gaṇa Nandyādi to Pāṇ. III. 1, 134; a fast horse, courser, (in this sense fr. rt. 1. जू and connected with जवन, for which it is sometimes a false reading); speed, velocity, (con-nected with rt. 1. जू); an Ionian, Greek, (in Uṇādi-s. II. 74. said to be fr. rt. 2. यु); a king of the Greeks; a Muhammadan, (sometimes applied to both the Muhammadan and European invaders of India as coming from the same quarter); any foreigner; a barbarian generally (Manu X. 44); the country of the Yavanas (sometimes applied to Bactria, Ionia, Greece, and more recently to Arabia); a carrot; olibanum; (आस्), m. pl. the Ionians or Greeks; the Greek astrologers; N. of a dynasty; (ई), f. a Greek or Muhammadan woman; the wife of a Yavana; = जवनी, a curtain. —यवन-देश, अस्, m. the country of the Yavanas. —यवनदेश-ज, ‘growing in the country of the Yavanas,’ styrax or benzoin. —यवन-द्विष्ट, अस्, m. ‘hated or disliked by Yavanas,’ bdellium. —यवन-पुर, अम्, n. the city of the Yavanas, (probably) Alex-andria. —यवन-प्रिय, अम्, n. ‘dear to Yavanas,’ pepper. —यवन-मुण्ड, अस्, m. a bald Yavana, one with a shaved head. —यवन-सेन, अस्, m. a proper N. —यवनाचार्य (°न-आच्°), अस्, m. an astronomical writer (frequently quoted by Varāha-mihira and other ancient Hindū astronomers, perhaps any Greek astronomer). —यवनारि (°न-अरि), इस्, m. ‘enemy of the Yavanas,’ N. of Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu; of a king of Vārāṇasī. —यवनेश्वर (°न-ईश्°), अस्, m., N. of the author of the Mīna-rāja-jātaka. —यवनेष्ट (°न-इष्°), अस्, आ, अम्, liked by the Yavanas; (अस्), m. a kind of onion or garlic; Azadirachta Indica; (आ), f. the wild date tree; (अम्), n. lead; an onion, garlic; pepper.
यवनक: यवनक, अस्, m. a particular kind of grain; (इका), f. = यवनी, a Yavana woman; = जवनिका, a curtain or screen, an outer tent, a screen of cloth surrounding a tent; a veil.
यवनानी: यवनानी, f. the writing of the Yavanas.
यवय: यवय यवय (fr. युवन्), Nom. P. यव-यति, -यितुम्, to make young.
यवयस: यवयस यवयस, अम्, n., N. of a Varṣa in Plaksha-dvīpa.
यवान: यवान यवान, अस्, आ, अम्, quick, swift, rash, (incorrectly for जवान, part. fr. rt. 1. जू।)
यवाषिक: यवाषिक, see Gaṇa 1. Kumudādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80.
यवाषिन्: यवाषिन्, see Gaṇa Prekṣādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80.
यविष्ठ: यविष्ठ यविष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. of युवन्), youngest, very young, last-born; (अस्), m. a younger brother; N. of Agni (called ‘the youngest’ or ‘last-born’ of the gods, either as produced from wood or as placed on the altar after everything else); N. of a Brāhman; (आस्), m. pl. his descendants; अग्नि यविष्ठ, N. of the author of the hymn Ṛg-veda VIII. 91; [cf. Old Germ. jungisto.] — 1. य-विष्ठ-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, containing the word य-विष्ठ. —२। यविष्ठ-वत्, ind. like a youth.
यविष्ठ्य: यविष्ठ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. youngest, = य-विष्ठ, (Sāy. = युवतम।)
यवीयस्: यवीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. of युवन्), younger; (आन्), m. a younger brother; a Śūdra (as opposed to one of the three higher castes); (असी), f. a younger sister; [cf. Goth. juhisa.]
यवीयस: यवीयस, अस्, m., N. of a preceptor.
यवीनर: यवीनर यवीनर, अस्, m., N. of a son of Ajamīḍha; of a son of Dvimīḍha and of Bharmyāśva and of Vāhyāśva.
यवीयुध्: यवीयुध् यवीयुध्, त्, त्, त् (fr. Intens. of rt. 1. युध्), Ved. eager to fight, fond of war, warlike, (also written यव्युध्।)
यश: यश at the end of a comp. = यशस्, cf. अति-य्°; (अम्), n., N. of a Sāman.
यशद: यशद यशद, अम्, n. a species of mineral (commonly called दस्ता, which according to some is zinc or pewter).
यशस्: यशस् यशस्, अस्, n. (in Uṇādi-s. IV. 190. said to be fr. rt. 1. अश्; according to some for ori-ginal दशस् = Lat. decus, fr. a lost rt. दश्), beautiful or handsome appearance, beauty, splendor, magnifi-cence, worth, excellence (Ved.); honour, glory, praise, renown, fame, reputation, distinction, cele-brity; Fame (personified as the son of Kāma and Rati or of Dharma and Kīrtti); an object of honour or respect, a person of respectability; favour, parti-ality (Ved.); = उदक, water (Ved.); अन्न, food (Ved.); = धन, wealth (Ved.); N. of a Sāman; (आस्), m. a proper N.; (आस्, आस्, अस्), Ved. beautiful, handsome, splendid, resplendent; worthy, excellent; renowned, honoured, respected, venerated; pleasant, pleasing, agreeable, estimable; [cf. Gr. δοκ-έ-ω, δόξα, δόγμα, δοκεύω, διδάσκω, δάκτυλος; Lat. dec-et, decus, dignu-s, doceo; probably Angl. Sax. ta, tah; Old Germ. zeha.] —यशः-कर्ण, अस्, m., N. of a king. —यशः-काय, अस्, m. a body consisting of fame or glory, i. e. glory, reputation. —यशः-केतु, उस्, m., N. of various kings. —यशः-पटह, अस्, m. a drum, a double drum. —यशः-पाल, अस्, m., N. of a king. —यशः-प्रख्यापन, अम्, n. spreading abroad or proclaiming the glory (of any one). —यशः-शरीर, अम्, n. = यशः-काय above. —यशः-शेष, अस्, आ, अम्, having nothing left but glory or fame, i. e. dead; (अस्), m. death, dying. —यशश्-चन्द्र, अस्, m., N. of a king. —यशस्-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing renown, conferring fame or distinction, famous, glorious; (अस्), m., N. of various men. —यशस्कर-स्वामिन्, N. of a temple founded by a certain Yaśas-kara. —यशस्-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, honour-loving, desirous or eager for fame, ambitious. —यशस्-काम्य, Nom. P. -काम्यति, &c., to desire honour or fame, be eager for renown. —यशस्-काम्यत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, desiring fame, de-sirous of glory. —यशस्-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, causing honour, conferring dignity or renown. —यशस्-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. most renowned or resplendent. —य-शस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing honour or glory, full of honour, honourable, glorious, famous; pleasant, pleasing, excellent, handsome; agreeable, estimable; (अती), f., N. of a woman. —यशस्वि-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, most famous or renowned. —यशस्-विन्, ई, इनी, इ, possessing honour or glory, renowned, famous, cele-brated, glorious; excellent, handsome; (इनी), f. epithet of a particular artery; N. of several plants, wild cotton (= वन-कार्पासी, यव-तिक्ता, महा-ज्योतिष्मती); N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda. —यशो-गोपि, इस्, m., N. of a commentator on the Śrauta-sūtras of Kātyāyana. —यशो-घ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, de-stroying the appearance or beauty (Ved.); destroying fame or reputation. —यशो-द, अस्, आ, अम्, glory-giving, bestowing distinction, conferring fame or renown; (अस्), m. quicksilver; (आ), f., N. of the wife of the cowherd Nanda, (she resided at Go-kula, and was the foster-mother of Kṛṣṇa, who immedi-ately after his birth as son of Devakī and Vasu-deva was entrusted to her care, that he might be protected from the enmity of Kaṃsa); N. of the wife of Mahā-vīra and daughter of Samara-vīra; N. of the daughter of a class of Manes. —यशो-दत्त, अस्, m. a proper N. —यशो-दा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. glory-giving, conferring beauty, (for यशो-दा, f. of यशो-द, see above.) —यशोदा-गर्भ-सम्भूता, f. epithet of Durgā. —यशोदा-नन्द, अस्, m. Yaśo-dā's son, i. e. Kṛṣṇa. —यशो-देव, अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist mendicant; of a son of Rāma-candra; (ई), f., N. of a daughter of Vainateya and wife of Bṛhan-manas. —यशो-धन, अम्, n. a fund or stock of fame; (अस्, आ, अम्), whose wealth consists of fame, rich in renown, renowned, famous (said of persons); (अस्), m., N. of a king. —यशो-धर, अस्, आ, अम्, maintaining or preserving glory, uphold-ing renown; (अस्), m., N. of the fifth day of the civil month (कर्म-मास); of the eighteenth Arhat of the preceding and of the nineteenth of the future Utsarpiṇī; of a son of Kṛṣṇa by Rukmiṇī, (also read यशो-वर); of various other men; (आ), f., N. of the fourth night of the civil month; of the mother of Rāhula; of several other women. —यशो-धा, आस्, आस्, अम्, conferring splendor or fame. —यशो-धामन्, अ, n. site or abode of glory. —यशो-नन्दि, इस्, m., N. of a king. —यशो-भ-गिन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. possessing fame, rich in glory, famous, renowned. —यशो-भगीन, अस्, आ, अम्, or यशो-भग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved., see Pāṇ. IV. 4, 131. —यशो-भद्र, अस्, m. (with Jainas) N. of one of the six Śruta-kevalins. —यशो-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, bearing fame, possessing renown, famous, renowned; bring-ing glory. —यशो-मती, f., N. of the third lunar night. —यशो-मत्य, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people. —यशो-माधव, अस्, m. a form of Viṣṇu. —य-शो-मित्र, अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist author. —यशो-राज, अस्, m. a proper N. —यशो-राशि, इस्, m. a heap or mass of glory, a glorious deed. —यशो-लेखा f., N. of a princess. —यशो-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing fame or glory; (अती), f., N. of various women; of a district (originally of a stream; some-times abbreviated into यशो-वति); of a mythical town on mount Meru. —यशो-वर, अस्, m., N. of a son of Kṛṣṇa by Rukmiṇī, (see यशो-धर।) —यशो-वर्त्मन्, अ, n. the path of glory, road to fame. —यशो-वर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a poet; of several other men, (यशो-वर्मक is found at the end of an adj. comp.) —यशो-हन्, आ, घ्नी, अ, de-stroying fame or reputation. —यशो-हर, अस्, आ, अम्, taking away fame, depriving of reputation, dishonouring; N. of a place, (gender doubtful.) —यशोहर-जित्, त्, m., N. of Kacu-rāya. —यशो-हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, shorn of fame or glory.
यशस: यशस at the end of a comp. = यशस्।
यशस्य: यशस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, famous, glorious, renowned, celebrated, honoured; bestowing glory or distinction, producing fame, creditable; (आ), f., N. of a plant (= जीवन्ती); of another plant (= ऋद्धि).
यशस्यु: यशस्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. seeking favour.
यष्टिक: यष्टिक, अस्, m. a species of water-fowl (= जल-कुक्कुट; cf. को-यष्टि); a bird, the lapwing; (आ), f. a staff, stick, club; a particular pearl ornament or necklace (especially of one string); an oblong pond or tank; liquorice.
यष्टी: यष्टी। See under 2. यष्टि, p. 812, col. 3.
यष्ट्रस्क: यष्ट्रस्क यष्ट्रस्क (?), आस्, m. pl., N. of a people.
यस्: यस् यस् (probably connected with rt. यम्), cl. 4. 1. P. यस्यति, यसति, य-यास, यसितुम्, to froth up, foam (Ved.; but ac-cording to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VII. 104, 2, ययस्तु = आयासम् प्राप्नोतु = उपक्षीयताम्), to make great effort or exertion, strive, endeavour, labour, preserve, trouble one's self; to strive after (with dat.); [cf. Gr. ζέ-ω, (ζέν-νυμι, ἔ-ζεσ-μαι, ζέσ-σε-ν), ζέα-μα, ζέ-μα, ζέ-σι-ς, ζεσ-τό-ς, ζῆ-λο-ς; Old Germ. jes-an, ger-ja-n.]
यसित्वा: यसित्वा or यस्त्वा, ind. making effort, endeavour-ing.
यस्क: यस्क, अस्, m. a proper N.; (आस्), m. pl. the de-scendants of Yaska; यस्का गैरिक्षिताः, N. of a school.
यस्य: यस्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be endeavoured, to be done with energy or perseverance; (according to a com-mentator) = वध्य, to be killed, fit or ready for slaughter. —यस्य-त्व, अम्, n. effort, energy; fit-ness for slaughter; death.
यस्मात्: यस्मात् यस्मात्, ind. (abl. of 3. य or यद्; correlative of तस्मात्, q. v.), from which, from which cause, since, as, because; that, in order that.
यह: यह यह, अस्, m. or यहस्, अस्, n., Ved. water; strength, power.
यहु: यहु यहु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. = महत्, great; (उस्), m. = अपत्य, offspring, a child, (in Ṛg-veda VIII. 60, 13, Agni is called सहसो यहुः, Sāy. = सहसः पुत्रः।)
यह्व: यह्व, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. = महत्, great, mighty, powerful, &c.; (perhaps) being in continual motion or activity, restless, active; continual, perpetual (said of Agni, Rudra, and Soma); continually moving or flowing; (व्यस्), f. pl., Ved. flowing or running water, a river, (सप्त यह्वीः, the seven great rivers); (वी), f. du. epithet of heaven and earth, of night and day, of evening and morning, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda 1. 142, 7, यह्वी means ‘the two children,’ according to some it may mean ‘the two hands’); (अस्), m. = यजमान, a sacrificer (accord-ing to Uṇādi-s. 1. 154).
यह्वत्: यह्वत् (fem. अती), Ved. = यह्व above; (accord-ing to Sāy. यह्वती = महती, great.)
या: या 1. या, cl. 2. P. (ep. also A.) याति (-ते), Impf. अयात् (3rd pl. अयान् or अयुस्), Pot. यायात्, Impv. यातु (2nd sing. याहि), ययौ (2nd sing. ययाथ or ययिथ, 1st pl. ययिम, Part. ययिवस्), यास्यति, अयासीत् (Vedic forms अयासुस्, यासत्, यासिष्ठम्, यासीष्ट), यातुम् (Ved. यातवे, यातवै), to go, proceed, move, set out, march, travel, journey; to go away, withdraw, retire; to pass away, pass by, elapse (said of time); to extend, last (said of time, e. g. मासं याति, it lasts for a month); to take place, come to pass, prosper, succeed; to proceed, behave, act; to go or come to, travel or journey towards, approach, arrive at, reach (with acc. or even dat. or loc. or with प्रति after an acc.); to go or march against; to go to any state or con-dition, to become, be (with acc. and especially acc. of an abstract noun, e. g. विनाशं याति, he goes to destruction, i. e. he is destroyed; काठिन्यं याति, it goes to hardness, i. e. becomes hard); to under-take, obtain, get (with acc.); to go in to, have carnal intercourse with (with acc.); to go to for any object, request, implore, solicit (with double acc., e. g. यामि वो द्रविणम्, I go to you for money, I solicit wealth of you; त्वां शरणं यामि, I go to thee for help); to find out, discover, perceive. The meanings of या may be variously extended by com-bining it with other words and phrases, e. g. प-लाय्य या, to run away; बहिर् या, to go out; अधो या, to go down, sink; क्षेमेण या, to escape safely; खण्डशो या, to fall to pieces; शत-धा या, to fall into a hundred pieces; यात्रां या, to undertake a journey; मृगयां या, to go out hunting; शिरसा महीं या, to bow down to the ground with the head; अगोचरं नयनयोर् या, to become invisible; द्वेष्यतां या, to become hated; विलयं या, to be dissolved; कर्णौ या, to come to the ears, be heard; करे या, to come to hand, be obtained; वशं या, to be subject to (with gen.); प्रकृतिं या, to return to one's natural state; निद्रां या, to fall asleep; निधनं या, to die; दर्शनं या, to become visible, be seen; उदयं या, to rise (said of stars, &c.): Pass. यायते, to be gone, &c.: Caus. यापयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अयीयपत्, to make or cause to go or proceed, cause to set off or march, command to go away, drive away, remove, cure (a disease); to cause to pass by or elapse, pass or spend (as time, night, &c.); to cause to subsist, support; to cause to arrive at or obtain (with a double acc., e. g. तं श्रियं या-पयति, he causes him to obtain fortune); to induce: Desid. यियासति, to wish or intend to go, to desire to proceed, &c.: Intens. यायायते, यायेति, यायाति, to go frequently, &c.; [cf. Gr. ἰάπτω (= Caus. या-पयामि), ἵημι, ἥ-σω (= यास्यामि), perhaps also some forms like ἰέναι: Lat. jacio; Janus, janua.]
2. या, आस्, आस्, अम् [cf. 4. य, p. 801, col. 1], going, proceeding, moving, &c. (at the end of a comp., see एव-या, तुर-या, देव-या).
या 3. या, fem. of the relative pronoun यद्। See p. 807, col. 3.
यात्: 1. यात्, यान्, याती or यान्ती, यात् (for 2. यात् see s.v.), going, proceeding, moving; that which moves (e. g. Ṛg-veda I. 32, 15, इन्द्रो यातो ऽवसितस्य राजा, Indra the sovereign of all that is movable and im-movable). —यात्-सत्त्र, अम्, n., Ved. ‘continuing sacrifice,’ N. of certain solemn ceremonies which go on for a long period, (also called Sārasvata.)

यात् 2. यात्, ind. (properly obsolete abl. fr. the pronom. base 3. य, cf. तात्; for 1. यात् see p. 813, col. 2, for 3. यात् see below), inasmuch as, so far as, so long as, since, (but according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda 1. 80, 15, यात् = यान्तम्, pervading; VII. 88, 4, यात् = यातः = गच्छतः, passing; VI. 21, 6, यात् = यानि [कर्माणि], which [actions]; according to some यात् is an interjection of pleasure; of alarm; of restlessness.) —याच्-छ्रेष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (i. e. यात् + श्रेष्ठ), Ved. the best possible; [cf. यावच्-छ्रेष्ठ; but according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda III. 53, 21, यात् is a separate word, and means ‘an enemy,’ as if fr. rt. 2. यत्।]
यात् 3. यात् (fr. rt. 2. यत्), in ऋण-यात्, Ved. the avenger of guilt or debt.
यात: यात, अस्, आ, अम्, gone, proceeded, marched, passed, &c.; gone to, attained, obtained (with acc.); passed by or away, elapsed, escaped; (अम्), n. the act of going, going, march, proceeding; motion, (often confounded with यान, q. v.); the past time (e. g. यातम् अनागतं च, the past and the future); the guiding or driving of an elephant with a goad. —यात-याम, अस्, आ, अम्, or यात-यामन्, आ, आ, अ, that which has completed its course or (ac-cording to others) that which has stood for a night (and so become flat and stale), used, spoiled, im-paired, useless, rejected; raw, half ripe; who or what has run out or completed a course, exhausted, old, aged. —यातयाम-त्व, अम्, n. uselessness, unprofitableness; old age. —यातानुयात (°त-अन्°), अम्, n. the going and following. —यातायात (°त-आय्°) or यातोपयात (°त-उप्°), अम्, n. a going and coming; intercourse. —यातोपयातिक, see Gaṇa Akṣa-dyūtādi to Pāṇ. IV. 4, 19.
यातव्य: 1. यातव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be gone or set out, to be marched; to be gone against, to be assailed or attacked, (the neuter is used impersonally.)
2. यातव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 2. यातु below), service-able against witchcraft, keeping off Rākṣasas.
याति: याति, इस्, f. (said to be fr. the Intens.), see Pāṇ. I. 1, 58.
यातिक: यातिक, अस्, m. a traveller, (probably incorrect for यात्रिक।)
यातु: 1. यातु, 3rd sing. Impv. of rt. 1. या above (often used as an interjection), let it go, let it pass, be it so, no matter.

2. यातु, उस्, उस्, उ, a goer, one who goes or moves; (उस्), m. a traveller, wayfarer; wind; time; (perhaps) sorcery, witchcraft, (but according to Sāy. यातु means either कर्मणां हिंसा, injury of rites, or पीडा, pain, torture); a kind of evil spirit, Rākṣasa, demon; (उ), n. a weapon, (according to Sāy. as inflicting यातना, pain); a Rākṣasa, evil spirit, demon. —यातु-घ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, destroying Yātus; (अस्), m. bdellium. —यातु-चातन, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. ‘Yātu-removing,’ driving away Rākṣasas. —यातु-जम्भन, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. ‘Yātu-destroying,’ de-stroying Rākṣasas or demons. —यातु-जू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ, Ved. incited by Yātus, impelled by Rākṣasas; (Sāy.) pressing forwards or eager to torment (said of demons). —यातु-धान, अस्, m. an evil spirit, Rākṣasa, demon; (ई), f. a female Rākṣasa. —यातु-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. practising witchcraft or sorcery, evil-disposed, injurious, malignant; composed of demons or Rākṣasas, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda 1. 133, 2, यातु-मत् means either ‘possessing injury,’ ‘in-flicting injury,’ or ‘possessing injurious weapons,’ or ‘possessing demons.’) —यातु-विद्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. skil-ful in sorcery or witchcraft, learned in the practices of Rākṣasas. —यातु-हन्, आ, घ्नी, अ, Ved. destroy-ing witchcraft.
यातुमावत्: यातु-मावत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. (according to the Pada text of the Ṛg-veda and Atharva-veda Prāti-śākhya IV. 8. this word is divided यातु-मावत्, not यातुमा-वत् as might be expected), = यातु-मत्, ‘practising sorcery, &c.,’ (but according to Sāy. यातु = यातना, ‘torment,’ and मा = व्यापार, ‘practice,’ as if fr. 2. यातु with rt. 3. मा।)
यातृ: 1. यातृ, ता, त्री, तृ (for 2. see p. 815, col. 2), going, proceeding, &c., being on a journey or march; (ता), m. a goer, traveller; a driver, charioteer, coach-man; a destroyer, slayer, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 32, 14 = हन्तृ; according to modern scholars the meaning may be ‘an avenger,’ as if fr. rt. 2. यत्; cf. 3. यात्, ऋण-या।)
यातृ 2. यातृ, ता, f. (acc. यातरम्, nom. acc. du. यातरौ, nom. pl. यातरस्; said in Uṇādi-s. II. 98. to be fr. rt. 2. यत्), a husband's brother's wife. (For 1. यातृ see p. 813, col. 3.)
यातृक: यातृक, अस्, m. a wayfarer, traveller, (wrongly for यात्रिक।)
यात्रा: यात्रा, f. going, setting off, journey, travel, march, the march of an army, expedition, (यात्रां या or दा, to undertake an expedition or campaign, take the field); going on a pilgrimage; a company of pilgrims; a festive train, procession, the procession of idols; a feast, festival (= उत्सव); a sort of dramatic entertainment; a road; support of life, livelihood, subsistence, provisions; passing away time; going to and fro; intercourse, (लौकिकी यात्रा or जगद्-यात्रा, worldly intercourse); way, means, ex-pedient; practice, usage, custom; N. of a particular kind of astrological work (especially of one by Varāha-mihira, the full title of which is Yoga-yātrā). —या-त्रा-करण, अम्, n. the setting forth on a journey, a march. —यात्रा-कार, अस्, m. the author of a work of the Yātrā class. —यात्रा-गमन, अम्, n. the going on a journey or expedition. —यात्रा-प्रसङ्ग, अस्, m. engaging in or performing a pilgrimage. —यात्रा-फल, अम्, n. the fruit of an expedition, success of a campaign. —यात्रा-महोत्सव (°हा-उत्°), अस्, m. a great festive procession. —यात्रार्-थम् (°रा-अर्°), ind. for the sake of marching. —या-त्रोत्सव (°रा-उत्°), अस्, m. a festive procession.
यात्रा यात्रा, यात्रिक, &c. See p. 813, col. 3.
यात्रिक: यात्रिक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to a march, relating to an expedition or campaign, marching, journeying, performing a pilgrimage; relating to the support of life, requisite for subsistence; customary, usual; (अस्), m. a traveller; a pilgrim; (अम्), n. a march, expe-dition, campaign; provisions for a march, supplies, &c.; N. of a particular class of astrological works; [cf. यात्रा।]
यात्रिन्: यात्रिन्, ई, इणी, इ, being on a march, being in a procession.
यान: यान, अस्, अम्, m. n. way, road, path (Ved.); (अम्), n. the act of going, moving, riding; marching or proceeding (against an enemy), attacking; re-treating, retreat; a journey; a procession; a con-veyance or vehicle of any kind, carriage, waggon, chariot, car; a litter, palanquin; (with Buddhists) the vehicle or means of arriving at knowledge, the means of release from repeated births; (ई), f., see Gaṇa Gaurādi to Pāṇ. IV. 1, 41; [cf. Lat. janua.] —यान-कर, अस्, m. ‘carriage-maker,’ a wheel-wright, carpenter. —यान-पात्र or यान-पात्रक, अम्, n. ‘going-vessel,’ a ship, boat. —यानपात्रिका, f. a small vessel, boat. —यान-भङ्ग, अस्, m. the fracture of a vessel or boat, shipwreck. —यान-मुख, अम्, n. the fore part of a waggon or chariot, the pole or part where the yoke is fixed. —यान-यान, अम्, n. riding in a carriage, driving in a chariot, a drive. —यान-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a carriage or vehicle; travelling in a carriage. —यान-शाला, f. a coach-house, cart-shed. —यान-स्वामिन्, ई, m. the owner of a vehicle.
यानक: यानक, अस्, m. a vehicle, carriage.
याप: याप, अस्, m. (fr. the Caus.), the causing to go; [cf. काल-य्°।]
यापक: यापक, अस्, इका, अम् (fr. the Caus.), causing to go or come, causing to pass away or spend, bringing, granting, bestowing.
यापक यापक, यापन, याप्ता। See p. 814, col. 1.
यापन: यापन, अस्, ई, अम्, causing to go or pass away, bringing to an end; mitigating, alleviating, curing; prolonging or supporting life; (आ, अम्), f. n. the causing to go, act of driving away or expelling, ex-pulsion, removal, rejection; the cure or alleviation (of a malady); the causing (time) to pass away, spending time, wasting time, delay, procrastination; loitering, staying; maintenance, support (= वर्तन, यात्रा); exercise, practice.
यापनीय: यापनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be caused to go, to be passed or spent (as time); to be removed or cured, to be expelled.
यापयत्: यापयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, causing to go or pass, spending.
यापित: यापित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to go; spent (as time); expelled.
याप्ता: याप्ता, f. twisted or plaited hair (= जटा).
याप्य: याप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be passed or spent (as time); to be removed or cured; to be expelled or rejected; low, vile, contemptible, little, trifling, unimportant. —याप्य-त्व, अम्, n. curability. —याप्य-यान, अम्, n. a palanquin, litter.
याम: 1. याम, अस्, m. (for 2. याम see p. 816, col. 1), motion, course, going, proceeding, coming; a road, way, path (Ved.); progress (Ved.); a carriage, chariot (Ved.); a night-watch, period or watch of three hours, the eighth part of a day; a wandering star, planet (?); यामस्य अर्कः, N. of a Sāman; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a class of gods; (ई), f., N. of a daughter of Dakṣa (wife of Dharma or Manu; sometimes written Yāmi); N. of an Apsaras; night. —याम-कोश, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. covering up or obstructing the way, (Sāy. = मार्ग-प्रतिबन्-धक।) —याम-घोष, अस्, m. ‘sounding the watches,’ a cock; a metal plate on which the night-watches or hours are struck, a drum or gong used for a similar purpose, (in this sense said to be also आ, f.) —याम-तूर्य, अम्, n. or याम-दुन्दुभि, इस्, m. or याम-नाली, f. a kind of drum or metal plate on which the night-watches or hours are struck, a clock. —याम-मात्र, अम्, n. a mere watch, only three hours. —याम-यम, अस्, m. a regular or stated occupation for every hour. —याम-वती, f. ‘possessing watches,’ night. —याम-वृत्ति, इस्, f. the being on watch, standing on guard. —याम-श्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, renowned for going or speed, (Sāy. = शिघ्र-गमनेन विश्रुत।)

याम 2. याम, अस्, m. (fr. rt. यम्; for 1. याम see p. 814, col. 1), restraint, forbearance, &c., = याम; (अस्, ई, अम्), relating to Yama, (in this sense fr. यम); coming or derived from Yama, done or ordered by Yama; (अम्), n., N. of several Sāmans. —यामोत्तर (°म-उत्°), अम्, n., N. of a Sāman.
यामन्: 1. यामन्, अ, n. (for 2. see p. 816, col. 1), Ved. going, motion, course; flight, flying; coming, arrival; a march, expedition; the act of approaching or addressing (with prayers, entreaties, &c.), invocation, supplication; offering, oblation, sacrifice, (यामन् is used in some passages as a Ved. loc. without ter-mination); पुनर्-यामन्, आ, आ, अ, coming into use again; [cf. यात-यामन्।] —याम-हू, ऊस्, ऊस्, उ, Ved. one who allows himself to be invoked by prayers or offerings, ready or inclined to assist; (Sāy.) to be invoked to come or to be invoked at the right time (= गमनार्थम् आह्वातव्य or काले ह्वातव्य). —याम-हूति, इस्, f., Ved. invo-cation for assistance; (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VIII. 8, 18, याम-हूतिषु = देवानाम् आह्वानं येषु यागेषु, in sacrifices at which there is an invocation of the gods.)
2. यामन् = यामिन् in अन्तर्-यामन्। (For 1. see p. 814, col. 1.)
यामि: 1. यामि = यामी under 1. याम। (For 2. यामि see p. 816, col. 2.)
यामि 2. यामि, इस्, or यामी, f. (for 1. यामि see p. 814, col. 2), = जामि, स्वसृ, a sister, female relation; a daughter-in-law; a woman of rank or respectability (= कुल-स्त्री).
यामिक: यामिक, अस्, आ, अम्, being on watch or guard; (अस्), m. a night-watcher, watchman, one who an-nounces the watches, one on guard or duty at night; (इका), f. = यामिनी, night. —यामिक-भट, अस्, m. a night-watcher, watchman.
यामिनय: यामिनय (fr. यामिनी), Nom. P. यामिनयति, यितुम्, to appear like night.
यामिनी: यामिनी, f. (fr. 1. याम), night (as possessing watches); N. of a daughter of Prahlāda; of the wife of Tārkṣa (mother of Śalabha). —यामिनी-पति, इस्, m. the husband or lord of night, the moon.
यामिनी यामिनी, यामीर। See. p. 814, col. 2.
यामीर: यामीर, अस्, m. the moon; (आ), f. night.
यामेय: 1. यामेय, अस्, m. (fr. 1. यामि), a metronymic.
2. यामेय, अस्, m. (for 1. see p. 814, col. 2), a sister's son, nephew.
याम्या: याम्या, f. (fr. 1. याम), = यामिनी, night, (for या-म्या, the south, see under याम्य, p. 816, col. 1.)
यायावर: यायावर, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Intens.), going repeatedly; wandering in all directions, having no fixed or permanent abode; (अस्), m. a vagrant men-dicant, saint; a horse selected for the horse sacrifice (‘wandering at large’); a Brāhman who has pre-served his household fire (?); N. of Jarat-kāru; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a family of Brāhmans (to which Jarat-kāru belonged); (अम्), n. the life of a wan-dering beggar.
यायावर यायावर, यायिन्। See p. 814, col. 2.
यायिन्: यायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, going, moving, travelling, jour-neying, marching, running, riding, driving, flying; a traveller, passenger; riding or going in or on, (generally at the end of comps., e. g. गज-यायिन्, riding on an elephant; cf. नौ-य्°); going to, jour-neying towards; going on an expedition, taking the field, going to war; opposing each other (said of planets; cf. ग्रह-युद्ध).
यावन्: 1. यावन्, आ, m. (for 2. see p. 817, col. 1), Ved. a rider, horseman, horse-soldier; an invader, aggres-sor, enemy, (Sāy. = अभिगन्तृ); going, driving, riding (at the end of a comp.; cf. अग्र-य्°, पूर्व-य्°).
यावन् 2. यावन् = 1. यव। (For 1. यावन् see p. 814, col. 2.)
यावन् 3. यावन् (fr. rt. 1. यु) in ऋण-यावन्, q. v.; [cf. 2. यव।]
यास्यत्: यास्यत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, about to go, about to proceed.
यियासु: यियासु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. the Desid.), wishing to go, intending to set off or depart, desirous of taking the field or entering on an expedition; intending to fly away.
याकृत्क: याकृत्क याकृत्क (fr. यकृत्), see Pāṇ. VII. 3, 51.
याक्ष: याक्ष याक्ष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. यक्ष), be-longing or peculiar to the Yakṣas.
याग: याग याग, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. यज्), an offer-ing, oblation, sacrifice; any ceremony in which offerings and oblations are presented. —याग-कर्-मन्, अ, n. a sacrificial rite or ceremony. —याग-काल, अस्, m. time of sacrifice. —याग-मण्डप, अस्, अम्, m. n. a hall for sacrifices, a temple. —याग-सन्तान, अस्, m., N. of Jayanta (son of Indra). —याग-सूत्र, अम्, n. the sacrificial cord, sacred thread, (see यज्ञ-सूत्र।)
याच्: याच् याच्, cl. 1. P.A. याचति, -ते, य-याच, ययाचे, याचिष्यति, -ते, अयाचीत्, अयाचिष्ट, याचितुम्, to ask, beg, solicit, pray, re-quest, desire, entreat, require, implore, supplicate, importune (with double acc., e. g. देवं वरं याचते, he solicits a boon from the god; also with abl. and rarely with gen. of person, e. g. अन्नम् परात् or परस्य याचते he begs food from an-other; or the thing asked may be compounded with अर्थे or अर्थम्, e. g. मोक्षार्थम् याचते, he asks for deliverance; or may be in acc. with प्रति, e. g. सुतम् प्रति ययाचे, he asked for a son; or in dat., e. g. तं ययाचे ऽभ्यव-हाराय, he asked him for food); to offer any-thing (acc.) to any one (dat.), tender (e. g. याचति वित्तं गुरवे, he offers property to the Guru); to promise (?); कन्यां याच्, to be a suitor for a girl, to ask a girl in marriage from any one (abl. or rarely acc.): Pass. याच्यते: Caus. याचयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अययाचत्, to cause to ask, &c.: Desid. यियाचिषति, -ते, (in Ṛg-veda VIII. 67, 1, याचिषामहे = या-चामहे): Intens. यायाच्यते, यायाक्ति (1st sing. यायाच्मि), to ask repeatedly, importune; [cf. Gr. αἰτέω, which however may be connected with rt. अर्थ्; cf. also, according to some, ζητέω.].
याचक: याचक, अस्, ई, अम्, asking, one who asks or solicits, a petitioner, asker, beggar; (ई), f. a female beggar or petitioner. —याचक-वृत्ति, इस्, f. the occupation or profession of a beggar.
याचन: याचन, अम्, n. the act of asking, begging, re-questing; asking in marriage, (दुहितृ-याचन, the being a suitor for a daughter); (आ), f. asking, solicit-ing, requesting, entreating, petitioning; a request, petition, entreaty.
याचनक: याचनक, अस्, m. an asker, petitioner, an impor-tunate man.
याचनीय: याचनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be asked, to be desired or requested.
याचमान: याचमान, अस्, आ, अम्, asking, begging, re-questing, soliciting.
याचित: याचित, अस्, आ, अम्, asked, prayed for, begged, requested, solicited, entreated, importuned (with acc., e. g. दशरथो रामं याचितः, Daśaratha was asked for Rāma); requisite, necessary.
याचितक: याचितक, अम्, n. anything borrowed, any article borrowed for use.
याचितव्य: याचितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be asked or solicited.
याचितृ: याचितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who begs or solicits, an asker, petitioner; a suitor, wooer.
याचित्वा: याचित्वा, ind. having asked, having solicited.
याचिन्: याचिन्, ई, इनी, इ, asking, desiring, requesting.
याचिष्णु: याचिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, disposed to ask, habitually asking or begging, soliciting favours, importuning, an importunate person. —याचिष्णु-ता, f. the habit of soliciting favours, importunity.
याच्ञा: याच्ञा, f. the act of asking, requesting, begging, solicitation, asking alms, mendicancy, mendicity; a petition, request, prayer, entreaty; the being a suitor, making an offer of marriage. —याच्ञा-जीवन, अम्, n. subsisting by begging or mendicancy. —याच्-ञा-प्राप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, obtained by begging or asking. —याच्ञा-भङ्ग, अस्, m. failure of request, an unsuccessful entreaty, useless request. —याच्ञा-वचस्, अस्, n. words used in begging or entreating.
याच्ञ्य: याच्ञ्य, अस्, m. or याच्ञ्या, f., Ved. = याच्ञा above.
याच्य: याच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be asked or solicited, to be importuned, to be asked for alms, to be desired or requested; to be required; (अम्), n. the making a request.
याच्यमान: याच्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being asked or solicited, being prayed for.
याज्: याज् याज्, ट्, ट्, ट् (fr. rt. 1. यज्), one who sacrifices or offers oblations, an offerer, sacrificer; [cf. हयमेध-याज्।]
याज: याज, अस्, m. a sacrificer (in अति-य्°, q. v.); boiled or cooked rice; food in general; N. of a Brahmarṣi.
याजक: याजक, अस्, m. (fr. the Caus.), a sacrificer, sacri-ficing priest, one who offers sacrifices or oblations, a priest officiating at a sacrifice, (often at the end of a comp., cf. ग्राम-य्°, नक्षत्र-य्°; sometimes compounded with the person who institutes the sacri-fice, e. g. क्षत्रिय-याजक, the sacrificer for a Kṣatriya; cf. शूद्र-य्°); a royal elephant; a furious elephant or one in rut. —याजक-त्व, अम्, n. the condition or office of a sacrificing priest.
याजन: याजन, अम्, n. (fr. the Caus.), the act of con-ducting a sacrifice or causing it to be performed, superintending or assisting at the sacrifices of others, (sometimes with gen., e. g. व्रात्यानां याजनं कृत्वा, having officiated at a sacrifice for outcasts, Manu XI. 197; अयाज्य-याजन, sacrificing for those who have no right to sacrifice, Manu III. 65.)
याजनीय: याजनीय, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), to be made or allowed to sacrifice, to be assisted at a sacrifice, one for whom it is allowable to officiate.
याजमान: याजमान, अम्, n. (fr. यजमान), the part of a sacrificial ceremony performed by the Yajamāna or institutor of the sacrifice himself.
याजमानिक: याजमानिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the Yaja-māna, belonging to the institutor of a sacrifice.
याजयितृ: याजयितृ, ता, m. (fr. the Caus.), one who con-ducts a sacrifice or causes it to be performed, the officiating priest at a sacrifice.
याजि: याजि, इस्, f. a sacrifice, oblation; (इस्), m. accord-ing to Ujjvala-datta on Uṇādi-s. IV. 124 = यष्टृ, a sacrificer, the institutor of a sacrifice.
याजिन्: याजिन्, ई, इनी, इ, sacrificing, conducting a sacrifice, one who officiates at a sacrifice, a sacrificer, (usually at the end of comps.; cf. देव-य्°, बहु-य्°); wor-shipping, adoring.
याजुक: याजुक, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of comps.) habi-tually sacrificing or making offerings.
याज्ञ: याज्ञ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. यज्ञ), belonging to sacri-fice.
याज्ञ याज्ञ, याज्य। See col. 1. and above.
याज्ञतुर: याज्ञतुर, अस्, m. (fr. यज्ञ-तुर), a patro-nymic of Ṛṣabha; (अम्), n., N. of a Sāman.
याज्ञदत्तक: याज्ञदत्तक (fr. यज्ञ-दत्त), see Gaṇa Arī-haṇādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80.
याज्ञदत्ति: याज्ञदत्ति, इस्, m. a patronymic from Yajña-datta; Kuvera (?) .
याज्ञदेव: याज्ञदेव, अस्, m., N. of an author.
याज्ञपत: याज्ञपत (fr. यज्ञ-पति), see Gaṇa Aśva-patyādi to Pāṇ. IV. 1, 84.
याज्ञवल्क: याज्ञवल्क, अस्, ई, अम्, composed by or derived from Yājñavalkya; (आस्), m. pl. of याज्ञवल्क्य, see Gaṇa Kaṇvādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, III.
याज्ञवल्कीय: याज्ञवल्कीय, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to Yājñaval-kya, composed by or descended from Yājñavalkya; (अम्), n., scil. धर्म-शास्त्र, the code of Yājña-valkya.
याज्ञवल्क्य: याज्ञवल्क्य, अस्, m. (fr. यज्ञ-वल्क्य), N. of an ancient sage frequently quoted as an authority in the Śata-patha-Brāhmaṇa, (the first reputed teacher of the Vājasaneyi-saṃhitā or White Yajur-veda, revealed to him by the Sun, cf. तैत्तिरीय-संहिता, वाज-सनेयि-संहिता); N. of the author of a celebrated code of laws (by some identified with the preceding sage; this code is only second in importance to that of Manu, and with its most celebrated commentary, the Mitākṣara, is the leading authority of the Mithilā school; it is much later than Manu, and probably in its present form dates from about the first century of our era); the family of Yājñavalkya; (अम्), n., N. of an Upaniṣad; (अस्, की, अम्), relating to Yājñavalkya, composed by or derived from Yājña-valkya. —याज्ञवल्क्य-गीता, f., N. of a poem in commendation of the practice of Yoga attributed to Yājñavalkya. —याज्ञवल्क्य-टीका, f., N. of several commentaries on the code of Yājñavalkya (besides the Mitākṣara by Vijñāneśvara, there are other commentaries by Deva-bodha, Dharmeśvara, Bhāruci, Viśva-rūpa, and Śūla-pāṇi). —याज्ञवल्क्य-धर्-म-शास्त्र, अम्, n. Yājñavalkya's code of laws. —याज्ञवल्क्य-शिक्षा, f., N. of a treatise. —याज्-ञवल्क्य-स्मृति, इस्, f. the body of law as delivered by Yājñavalkya.
याज्ञसेन: याज्ञसेन, अस्, or याज्ञसेनि, इस्, m. (fr. यज्ञ-सेन), a patronymic of Śikhaṇḍin; (ई), f. a patro-nymic of Draupadī (as daughter of Yajñasena).
याज्ञायनि: याज्ञायनि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Yajña.
याज्ञिक: याज्ञिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or belonging to sacrifice, &c.; (अस्), m. a sacrificer or the officiating priest at a sacrificial ceremony, the institutor of a sacrifice, one skilled in sacrificial rites, a Ritualist; N. of various kinds of plants &c. used at a sacrifice; of Kuśa grass; of a red-flowering Khadira; the sacred fig-tree; Butea Frondosa. —याज्ञिक-देव, अस्, m., N. of a commentator on Kātyāyana's Śrauta-sūtra. —याज्ञिक-वल्लभा, f., N. of a work. —याज्-ञिकानन्त (°क-अन्°), अस्, m., N. of an author. —याज्ञिकाश्रय (°क-आश्°), अस्, m., N. of Viṣṇu.
याज्ञिक्य: याज्ञिक्य, अम्, n. (fr. याज्ञिक), the laws or ob-servances relating to sacrificial rites; sacrificial cere-monies in general, a sacrifice.
याज्ञिय: याज्ञिय, अस्, ई, अम्, = यज्ञिय, sacrificial, belong-ing to sacrifices; fit or suitable for sacrifice; (अस्), m. one skilled in sacrificial rites, (in this sense a various reading for याज्ञिक।)
याज्य: याज्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), to be made or allowed to sacrifice, one on whose behalf a sacrifice is made; to be sacrificed; sacrificial; (अस्), m. a sacrificer, performer of a sacrifice for others; the person for whom a sacrifice is performed, the master or insti-tutor of a sacrifice; (आ), f., scil. ऋच्, the sacred text uttered at the moment of making the offering, the words of consecration used at a sacrifice; (अम्), n. property or presents obtained by officiating at sacri-fices. —याज्य-ता, f. or याज्य-त्व, अम्, n. the rank or position of a sacrificer or of one for whom a sacrifice is performed. —याज्य-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. having the Yājyā or consecrating text.
याज्वन: याज्वन, अस्, m. (fr. यज्वन्), the son of a sacri-ficer.
याजुर्वैदिक: याजुर्वैदिक याजुर्वैदिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. यजुर्-वेद), belonging or relating to the Yajur-veda.
याजुष: याजुष, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the Yajus, belong-ing to the Yajur-veda; (अस्), m. an observer of reli-gious ceremonies as prescribed in the Yajur-veda.
याजुष्मती: याजुष्मती, f., scil. इष्टका, a kind of brick used for the sacrificial altar; [cf. यजुष्-मत्।]
यातन: यातन यातन, अम्, n. (fr. the Caus. of rt. 2. यत्), the act of requiting, requital, retaliation, recompense, reward, return; वैरस्य यातनम्, requital of hostile acts, revenge, vengeance; (आ), f. requital, (यातनाम् दा, to make requital, revenge); recompense, retaliation, reward [cf. वैर-य्°]; acute pain, torment, anguish, agony, (especially) punish-ment inflicted by Yama, the pains of hell; personified as the daughter of Fear (भय) and Death (मृत्यु). —यातनार्थीय (°ना-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, fit for tor-ment, capable of suffering, susceptible of the pains of hell.
यातयत्: यातयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, joining, connecting, uniting (Ved.); existing, animating (Ved.); requiting, re-compensing, &c. —यातयज्-जन, अस्, m., Ved. uniting or bringing men together; animating man-kind, impelling men to exertion (said of Mitra, Varuṇa, and Aryaman; according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda 1. 136, 3, the meaning as applied to Aryaman may be ‘tormenting [irreligious] men in hell’).
यातलराय: यातलराय यातल-राय, अस्, m., N. of a king.
यातस्रुच: यातस्रुच यातस्रुच, अम्, n. (fr. यत-स्रुच्), = यौक्तस्रुच, N. of a Sāman.
यातानप्रस्थ: यातानप्रस्थ यातानप्रस्थ, N. of a place. यातानप्रस्थक, relating to the above place.
यात्निक: यात्निक यात्निक, आस्, m. pl. (fr. यत्न), N. of a Buddhist school.
यात्य: यात्य यात्य, अस्, m. (fr. the Caus. of rt. 2. यत्), ‘to be tormented, subject to the torments of hell,’ an inhabitant of hell, a condemned spirit.
याथ: याथ याथ (fr. rt. 1 या), in दीर्घ-याथ, q. v.
याथाकथाच: याथाकथाच याथाकथाच, अम्, n. (fr. यथा कथा च), anything which occurs now and then; that which happens under any circumstances.
याथाकामी: याथाकामी, f. or याथाकाम्य, अम्, n. (fr. यथा-काम), the acting according to will or desire, doing as one thinks fit or proper, conformity to one's wishes.
याथातथ्य: याथातथ्य, अम्, n. (fr. यथा-तथम्), a proper state or condition, proper way or course, reality, rectitude, propriety, truth; (अम्, एन), ind. according to truth, in reality, as is proper. —याथा-तथ्य-तस्, ind. from the truth, according to truth, in reality.
याथात्म्य: याथात्म्य, अम्, n. (fr. यथात्मन्), real nature or essence, true character.
याथार्थिक: याथार्थिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. यथार्थ), con-formable to truth or reality, just, true, right, real.
याथार्थ्य: याथार्थ्य, अम्, n. conformity with truth or fact, consistency with reality, the true or real mean-ing; suitableness, justness, rightness, application, use, accomplishment, attainment of an object.
याथासंस्तरिक: याथासंस्तरिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. यथा-सम्-स्तर), letting the covering lie according (to the original position).
यादमान: यादमान यादमान, अस्, आ, अम् (Pres. part. A. fr. an old form याद्, which, according to Sāy., is a substitute for rt. याच्), Ved. closely connected with, seeking connection or association with, wishing to mix, (Sāy. = सङ्गतिं याचमान, but in Ṛg-veda VII. 69, 3 = गच्छत् or गमयत्।)
यादव: यादव यादव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. यदु), relating to Yadu, descended or coming from Yadu; (अस्), m. a descendant of Yadu; N. of Kṛṣṇa; of a lexi-cographer; of an astronomer; (आस्), m. pl. the descendants of Yadu; = माधवः, वृष्णयाः; (ई), f. a Yādava female; N. of Durgā; (अम्), n. a stock of cattle. —यादव-गिरि, N. of a country. —यादव-पण्डित, अस्, m. = यादव-व्यास. —या-दव-राय, अस्, m., N. of a king. —यादव-व्यास, अस्, m., N. of the author of the Siddhānta-saṅgraha and of a commentary on the Nyāya-siddhānta-mañ-jarī. —यादव-शार्दूल, अस्, m. ‘Yādava-tiger, chief of the Yādavas,’ N. of Kṛṣṇa. —यादवा-चार्य (°व-आच्°), अस्, m., N. of a teacher. —याद-वाभ्युदय (°व-अभ्°), अस्, m., N. of a work. —यादवेन्द्र (°व-इन्°), अस्, m., N. of Kṛṣṇa; of an author. —यादवोदय (°व-उद्°), अस्, m. ‘rise of the Yādavas,’ N. of a drama.
यादवक: यादवक, आस्, m. pl. the descendants of Yadu.
याद्व: याद्व, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. belonging to the family of Yadu; (अस्), m. a son or descendant of Yadu.
यादस्: यादस् यादस्, अस्, n. a fluid, water; a river; semen; desire, lust (Ved. originally ‘close carnal connection;’ cf. यादमान); any animal living in water, any large aquatic animal, a monster of the deep, sea monster; यादसां नाथः or यादसाम् प्रभुः or यादसाम् पतिः, ‘lord of sea ani-mals,’ N. of Varuṇa; the ocean. —याद-ईश, अस्, m. ‘lord of marine animals,’ the sea. —यादः-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord of sea animals,’ the ocean, sea; N. of Varuṇa. —यादो-नाथ, अस्, m. ‘lord of sea monsters,’ N. of Varuṇa. —यादो-निवास, अस्, m. ‘abode of sea animals,’ the ocean, sea.
यादु: यादु, उस्, m. a fluid, liquid, water.
यादुर: यादुर, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. embracing sensually or voluptuously, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I, 126, 6, यादुरी = बहु-रेतो-युक्ता।)
यादृक्ष: यादृक्ष या-दृक्ष, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 3. य + दृक्ष, fr. rt. 1. दृश्), looking or appearing like which, what like, which like, as like, of which sort or nature, (used correlatively to तादृक्ष, q. v.: cf. Gr. ἥλιξ, ἡλίκος; Lat. qualis.)
यादृश्: यादृश्, क्, क्, क् (Ved. nom. यादृङ्), or यादृश, अस्, ई, अम् (see 2. दृश्, दृश), which like, what like, as like, of whatever kind or nature, whoever, whichever, whatever, which, what, (used correlatively to तादृश् and तादृश); यादृश, तादृश, any one whatever, anybody whatsoever. —यादृग्-गुण, अस्, आ, अम्, of whatever qualities.
यादृच्छिक: यादृच्छिक यादृच्छिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. यद्-ऋच्छा), voluntary, spontaneous, independent; acci-dental, casual, unexpected; (अस्), m. an officiating priest who does as he pleases.
याद्राध्य: याद्राध्य याद्-राध्य, अस्, आ, अम् (i. e. 1. यात् + राध्य), obtainable by moving or living creatures, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda II. 38, 8 = गच्-छतां राध्य; or according to modern scholars, the word may be used adverbially, as if fr. 2. यात् + राध्यम्, ‘as far as is practicable,’ ‘as well or as quickly as possible,’ cf. याच्-छ्रेष्ठ।)
यान्त्रिक: यान्त्रिक यान्त्रिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. यन्त्र), belonging to instruments or implements, relating to blunt surgical instruments, (see यन्त्र); artificially or mechanically refined (said of sugar).
याभ: याभ याभ, अस्, m. (fr. rt. यभ्), sexual intercourse. —याभ-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having sexual intercourse.
याभिस्: याभिस् याभिस्, ind. (inst. pl. fem. fr. the pronom. base 3. य, see यद्), Ved. whereby, that, in order that.
यामक: यामक, औ, m. du., N. of the Nakṣatra Punar-vasū; (ई), f. the voc. यामकि is used as a term of abuse.
यामिन्: यामिन् in अन्तर्-यामिन्, q. v. (For यामिनी see p. 814, col. 2.)
याम्य: याम्य, अस्, -मी, अम्, relating or belonging to Yama, like or resembling Yama, &c., (याम्य ऋक्ष, the Nakṣatra Bharaṇī presided over by Yama); southern, southerly, (याम्ये or याम्येन, in the south, in a southerly direction); (अस्), m., scil. नर or पु-रुष or दूत, a servant of Yama; N. of Agastya; of Śiva; of Viṣṇu; sandal-wood; (आ), f. the lunar asterism Bharaṇī; scil. दिश् or आशा, the southern quarter, south, (for याम्या, night, see p. 814, col. 2.) —याम्य-तस्, ind. from the south. —याम्य-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha. —याम्य-पाश, अस्, m. the noose or fetter of Yama. —याम्यायन (°य-आय्°), अम्, n. the sun's progress south of the equator, the winter solstice (= दक्षिणायन)। —याम्योत्तर (°य-उत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, southern and northern, going from south to north. —याम्योत्तर-वृत्त, अम्, n. south and north circle, the solstitial colure. —याम्योद्भूत (°या-उद्°), अस्, आ, अम्, aris-ing or growing in the south; (अस्), m. a species of tree (= श्री-ताल).
यामदूत: यामदूत यामदूत, आस्, m. pl. (fr. यम-दूत), N. of a family.
यामरथ: यामरथ, अम्, n. (fr. यम-रथ), scil. व्रत, N. of a particular religious observance relating to Yama.
यामनेमि: यामनेमि यामनेमि, इस्, m., N. of Indra.
यामल: यामल यामल, अम्, n. = यमल, a pair; N. of a class of Tantra works, (often wrongly written जामल।)
यामलायन: यामलायन (fr. यमल), see Gaṇa Pakṣādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80.
यामलीय: यामलीय, अम्, n. (fr. यामल), N. of a work or of a class of works.
यामातृ: यामातृ यामातृ, ता, or यामातृक, अस्, m. = जामातृ, a daughter's husband, son-in-law; [cf. Gr. εἰνάτερ-ες; Lat. janitr-i-c-es; Old Germ. eidum; Angl. Sax. adhum.]
यामायन: यामायन यामायन, अस्, m. (fr. यम), a patronymic of various authors of Vedic hymns; of Ūrdhva-kṛśana; of Kumāra; of Damana; of Deva-śravas; of Mathita; of Śaṅkha; of Saṅkasuka.
यामी: यामी यामी। See under 1. याम, p. 814, col. 1, and 2. यामि above.
यामुन: यामुन यामुन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. यमुना), be-longing or relating to the river Yamunā (commonly called Jumna), coming from it, growing in it, &c.; (अस्), m. a metronymic; N. of a mountain; of an author; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people; (अम्), n., scil. आञ्जन, antimony, collyrium; N. of a Tīrtha. —यामुनाचार्य (°न-आच्°), अस्, m., N. of a pre-ceptor (author of the Stotra-ratna).
यामुन्दायनि: यामुन्दायनि यामुन्दायनि, इस्, m. a patro-nymic from Yamunda.
यामुन्दायनिक: यामुन्दायनिक or यामुन्दायनीय, अस्, m. patronymics from Yamunda, (used contemptuously, cf. Pāṇ. IV. 1, 149.)
यायजूक: यायजूक यायजूक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Intens. of rt. 1. यज्), frequently sacrificing, constantly mak-ing offerings, devout; (अस्), m. a performer of fre-quent sacrifices.
यायात: यायात यायात, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to Ya-yāti, belonging to Yayāti, &c.; (अम्), n., N. of the eighteenth chapter of the ninth book of the Bhāga-vata-Purāṇa (containing an account of Yayāti).
यार्कायण: यार्कायण यार्कायण, अस्, m. a patronymic.
याव: याव 2. याव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 3. यव), relat-ing to barley, consisting of barley, made or prepared from barely, = यावक; (अस्), m. a kind of food prepared from barley; lac or the red dye prepared from the cochineal insect.
यावक: यावक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a kind of food prepared from barley, barley-gruel; half ripe barley; awnless barley; forced rice; a sort of kidney-bean; a kind of pulse, Dolichos Biflorus; a kind of pulse said to be peculiar to Kaśmīra; lac, the red dye.
यावक्रीतिक: यावक्रीतिक, अस्, m. (fr. यव-क्रीत), one con-versant with the history of Yava-krīta.
यावत्: यावत् यावत्, आन्, अती, अत् (fr. the pronom. base 3. य; correlative of तावत्, q. v.), as great, as large, as much, as many (= Lat. quot), as often, as far, as long, how much, how many, of what sort or kind, (for examples see तावत्); यावत्-तावत्, ‘quantum-tantum,’ an expression used in algebra for the relation of the first unknown quantity and its co-efficient); यावन्तः कियन्तः, as many as. यावत्, ind. (i. e. acc. sing. neut. used adverbially), as greatly, as much as, as many as, as often as; as far as, as long as, while, whilst, during; meanwhile, in the mean time; as soon as, the moment that; till, until, until such a time as (with pres. or pot. or fut. or aor. or impf.); that, in order that; when (followed by the correlative तावत्, meaning ‘then’); even, just. यावत् meaning ‘during,’ ‘for,’ ‘until,’ ‘up to,’ ‘as far as,’ &c. is often used like a preposition with an acc. (e. g. वर्षं यावत्, for a year; मासम् एकं यावत्, during one month; यावद् वर्षाणि द्वादश, for twelve years; शतं जन्मानि यावत्, for a hundred births; सूर्योदयं यावत्, until sunrise; सर्प-विवरं यावत्, up to the serpent's hole); or with indeclinable words like अद्य (e. g. अद्य यावत्, up to to-day); or sometimes with a nominative followed by इति (e. g. अन्त इति यावत्, as far as the end; त्रिंशद् इति यावत्, as many as thirty, up to thirty; पञ्च यावद् इति, up to five); यावद्-आ and sometimes even यावत् alone may be used with a following abl. to express ‘up to,’ ‘as far as,’ ‘until,’ &c. (e. g. यावद्-आ समापनात् or simply यावत् समापनात्, until the completion); यावन् न, as long as not, before that, until that; न परम् or न केवलम् — यावत्, not only — but also; यावता, ind. (i. e. inst. c. used adverbially), as far as, as long as; up to, until; as soon as, the moment that; यावति, ind. (i. e. loc. c. used adverbially), as far as, as long as, &c.; [cf. Gr. ἧμος; Lat. quan-tus?]. —यावच्-छक्यम्, ind. (i. e. यावत् + शक्-यम्), as far as possible, according to ability. —या-वच्-छस्, ind. (i. e. यावत् + शस्), Ved. as often as, as many times as, in as many ways as. —यावच्-छस्त्रम्, ind. (i. e. यावत् + श्°), Ved. as far as the Śastra extends. —यावच्-छेषम्, ind. (i. e. यावत् + श्°), Ved. as much as is left, as many as remain. —यावच्-छ्रेष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (i. e. यावत् + श्°), Ved. the best possible. —यावच्-छ्लोकम्, ind. (i. e. यावत् + श्°), according to the number of the Ślokas. —यावज्-जन्म, ind. throughout life, all one's life long. —यावज्-जीवम् or यावज्-जीवेन, ind. throughout life, during the whole of life, for life, for the rest of life. —यावज्जीविक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. life-long, as long as life, lasting for life. —यावज्जीविक-ता, f. the lasting for life. —या-वत्-कपालम्, ind., Ved. according to the circum-ference of the cup or bowl. —यावत्-कामम्, ind., Ved. as much as one likes, according to desire, —यावत्-कालम्, ind. for the whole period, as long as (anything may last). —यावत्-कृत्वस्, ind., Ved. as often as, as many times as. —यावत्-तरसम्, ind., Ved. according to power or ability (= यावद्-बलम्, यथा-शक्ति). —यावत्-त्मूत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. as far as soaked with fat. —यावत्-प्रमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, as great, as big, as large. —यावत्-सं-सारम्, ind. as long as the world lasts. —यावत्-सत्त्वम्, ind. as far as ability goes, to the best of one's understanding. —यावत्-सबन्धु, ind., Ved. as far as relationship extends, inclusive of all relations. —यावत्-समस्त, अस्, आ, अम्, as many as form the whole, large as it is. —यावत्-स्वम्, ind., Ved. as much as one possesses, according to one's property. —यावद्-अङ्गीन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. forming as large a member or limb. —यावद्-अन्तम् or यावद्-अन्-ताय, ind. as far as the end, to the last. —यावद्-अभीक्ष्णम्, ind. for a moment's duration, for an instant. —यावद्-अमत्रम्, ind. corresponding to the number of the vessels, as many drinking-vessels as (there may be). —यावद्-अर्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, as many as necessary, corresponding to requirement; (अम्), ind. as much as may be useful, according to need. —यावद्-अह, अम्, n., Ved. the corresponding day (‘the how-manieth day’). —यावद्-आ-भूत-सम्प्लवम्, ind. up to the dissolution of the crea-tion, to the end of the world. —यावदायुः-प्र-माण, अस्, आ, अम्, measured by the duration of life, lasting for life. —यावद्-आयुषम्, ind., Ved. as long as life lasts, all through life, for the whole of life. —यावद्-आयुस्, ind. as long as life lasts, all through life, for life. —यावद्-इत्थम्, ind. as much as necessary. —यावद्-ईप्सितम्, ind. as far as agree-able, as much as desired. —यावद्-उक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. as far as stated, as much as stated. —यावद्-उत्तमम्, ind. up to the furthest limit or boundary. —यावद्-गमम्, ind. as fast as one can go, as quickly as possible. —यावद्-बलम्, ind. as far as strength goes, as long as strength lasts, to the best of one's ability, with all one's might or strength. —या-वद्-भाषित, अस्, आ, अम्, as far as has been said, as much as said. —यावद्-राज्यम्, ind. for the whole reign. —यावद्-वेदम्, ind. as much as gained or obtained. —यावद्-व्याप्ति, ind. to the utmost reach or extent. —यावन्-मात्र, अस्, आ, अम्, having which measure, of which size, as large, extending as far; moderate, insignificant, unimportant, diminutive, little; (अम्), ind. in some measure or degree, a little.
यावत्; add — इति यावत्, such is the meaning, just so far is the sense, (an expression used by com-mentators.)
यावतिथ: यावतिथ, अस्, ई, अम् (a kind of ordinal of यावत् or, according to some, an old superl.), ‘the how-manieth,’ ‘as-manieth,’ in how many soever degrees advanced.
यावन: यावन 1. यावन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. यवन; for 2. see col. 2, for 3. see col. 3), born or produced in the land of the Yavanas; (अस्), m. incense (as coming from the country of the Yavanas).
2. यावन, अम्, n. (fr. the Caus.; for 1. यावन see col. 1, for 3. see col. 3), the act of removing or keeping off.
3. यावन, अम्, n. (fr. the Caus.; for 1. see col. 1, for 2. see col. 2), the act of uniting or join-ing, mixing, mingling, blending.
यावनाल: यावनाल यावनाल, अस्, m. = यव-नाल, q. v.; (ई), f. sugar extracted from Yava-nāla. —या-वनाल-निभ or यावनाल-शर, अस्, m. a kind of cane or reed resembling the Yāvanāla.
यावयत्: यावयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत् (fr. the Caus.), causing to keep off, warding off, protecting. —यावयत्-सख, अस्, m. a protecting friend or companion. —याव-यद्-द्वेषस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. driving away hostile beings (said of Uṣas, who is supposed to make the Rākṣasas and other malignant spirits vanish at her approach).
यावशूक: यावशूक यावशूक, अस्, m. (fr. यव-शूक) = यव-क्षार, a kind of alkaline salt prepared from the ashes of burnt barley-straw.
यावस: यावस यावस, अस्, m. (fr. यवस), a heap or quantity of grass; fodder, provender, provisions.
यावास: यावास यावास (fr. यवास), see Gaṇa Pa-lāśādi to Pāṇ. IV. 3, 141.
याव्य: याव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be joined or mixed, to be united or mingled; miscible; = याप्य, unimportant, insignificant.
याशु: याशु याशु, n. (perhaps connected with rt. यस्), embracing, embrace, sexual union, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda 1. 126, 6. याशूनि = प्रजनन-सम्बन्धीनि कर्माणि = भोगाः।)
याशोधरेय: याशोधरेय याशोधरेय (fr. यशो-धरा), अस्, m. a metronymic of Rāhula (the son of Śākya-muni).
याशोभद्र: याशोभद्र याशोभद्र (fr. यशो-भद्र), अस्, m., N. of the fourth day of the civil month (कर्म-मास).
याष्टीक: याष्टीक याष्टीक (fr. 2. यष्टि), अस्, ई, अम्, armed with a stick or club, having a staff of office; (अस्), m. a warrior armed with a club.
यास: यास यास, अस्, m. = यवास, Alhagi Mau-rorum; (आ), f. a species of thrush, Turdus Salica.
यास्क: यास्क यास्क, अस्, m. (fr. यस्क), a patro-nymic, N. of the author of the Nirukta or commen-tary on the difficult Vedic words contained in the lists called Nighaṇṭus, (these consist of three divisions, 1. the Naighaṇṭuka or a list of synonymous words, 2. the Naigama or words usually occurring in the Veda only, 3. the Daivata or words relating to deities and sacrificial acts; according to some, these three lists were drawn up by Yāska himself, and then com-mented on in his Nirukta, which quotes Vedic pas-sages in illustration of the words, and is the oldest Vedic commentary extant; Yāska is supposed to have lived before Pāṇini); (आस्), m. pl. the pupils of Yaska.
यास्कायनि: यास्कायनि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Yāska.
यास्कायनीय: यास्कायनीय or यास्कीय, आस्, m. pl. the pupils of Yāskāyani.
यित्थ: यित्थ यित्थ, अस्, m. a proper N.
यियक्षत्: यियक्षत् यियक्षत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, or यिय-क्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Desid. of rt. 1. यज्), purposing to sacrifice, wishing to worship.
यियक्षु: यियक्षु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing or intending to sacrifice, desirous of worshipping.
यियविषु: यियविषु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to mix or blend; wishing to fill or cover.
यु: यु 1. यु (said in Dhātu-pāṭha XXIV. 23. to be अ-मिश्रणे, i. e. the opposite in meaning to rt. 2. यु below, which is मिश्रणे, but rt. 1. यु is entirely Vedic), cl. 3. P. युयोति, (युयुधि according to Pāṇ. III. 4, 88); Impv. 2nd sing. युयोधि; the other forms are Vedic, e. g. युयोत, युयवत्, यु-वन्त, अयावि, यावीस्, यूषम्, योषत्, योषति, यौषुस्, यौष्टम्, यौस्, Inf. योतवे, योतवै, योतोस्, Ved. to separate, remove, exclude, ward off; to protect from (with abl.); to keep off (with acc.); to drive away, scatter, (Sāy. = पृथक्-कृ); to keep apart, to be or remain separate, (Sāy. = पृथग्-भू); cl. 10. A. यावयते, &c., to despise (?): Caus. यवयति, यावयति, -यितुम्, to cause to separate or remove or keep off, &c.: Intens. योयू-यते, योयवीति, to be violently separated or rent asunder, (Sāy. = अत्यर्थम् पृथग्-भू।)

यु 2. यु (allied to rt. 1. युज्), cl. 2. P., cl. 9. P.A. यौति (3rd pl. युवन्ति), युनाति, युनीते, युयाव (2nd sing. युयविथ, 3rd pl. यु-युवुस्), युयुवे, यविष्यति, -ते, अयावीत्, अय-विष्ट, यवितुम्, (these forms are rarely found in classical Sanskrit, but the following are found in the older language, यौमि, युवते, युवासे, युवस्व, अयुवत, युते, युवते, युताम्, (नि) युयोतम्, यु-यवत्, युयुवे, युविता, (नि)यूय), to attach, har-ness, bind, fasten; to join, unite, connect; to mix, combine; to gain possession of (Ved.); to bestow, confer (Ved.); to worship, honour (according to Naigh. III. 14): Pass. यूयते, 1st Fut. याविता, 2nd Fut. याविष्यते, Aor. अयावि, Prec. याविषीष्ट, to be joined or mixed: Caus. यावयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अयीयवत्: Desid. of Caus. यियावयिषति: Desid. यियविषति, युयूषति, to wish to unite or join; to yoke: Intens. योयूयते, योयवीति, योयोति, to unite very closely; [cf. Gr. ζώ-ννυ-μι (perhaps for ζωσνυμι), ζώ-νη, ζῶστρον; Lat. juvare, jus, juro, jubere.]
यु 3. यु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. rt. 1. या), Ved. going, moving, (Sāy. = गच्छत्); coming to misfortune, incurring evil, (Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VIII. 18, 13 = यातृ, अपगमन-शील or दुःखं गच्छत्।)
यु 4. यु, the actual base of the dual and plural numbers of the second personal pro-noun, (see युष्मद्।)
युत्: 1. युत्, त्, त्, त् (for rt. 2. युत् see s.v.), keeping off, preventing.

युत् 2. युत् (allied to rts. जुत्, ज्युत्, द्युत्; for 1. युत् see p. 817, col. 2), cl. 1. A. योतते, &c., to shine; [cf. Hib. iudh, ‘a day;’ an-iudh, ‘to-day;’ iodhna, ‘brightness, purity;’ ‘clean, pure.’]
युत: 1. युत, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see col. 3), separated, separate. —युत-द्वेषस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. delivered from enemies, relieved from foes, (Sāy. = पृथग्-भूत-शत्रुक।)

2. युत, अस्, आ, अम् (often at the end of comps.), fastened to or on, attached to [cf. वडिश-य्°]; added, joined, united; connected or joined with, accom-panied, attended by, furnished with, endowed with, possessed of, filled with, covered with; (अम्), n. a particular measure of length = 4 Hastas.
युत युत, युतक। See under rts. 1. and 2. यु, p. 817.
यियविषा: यियविषा, f. (fr. the Desid.), the wish to mix or blend.

युति: युति, इस्, f. uniting, joining, junction, union; the being furnished with (with inst.); the obtaining pos-session of; the sum, total number; (in arithmetic) addition; (in astronomy) conjunction.
युक्: युक् युक् (?) or युत् (?), ind. badly, ill; (these appear to be wrong forms.)
युक्त: युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, yoked, joined, united, con-nected, attached, fastened, harnessed; used, em-ployed, prepared, fitted out, arranged, ready, arranged in regular order, adapted, fitted, fit, suitable, just, proper, right, moderate, due, (युक्तः कालेन यः, one who makes use of the right opportunity; आयति-युक्त, suitable or profitable for the future); ap-pointed, engaged, occupied; fixed on, intent on (with loc. or at the end of a comp.); occupied with, immersed in, engaged in, absorbed in, attentive, attached to, given up or devoted to, absorbed in abstract meditation or in the religious exercise called Yoga; exercised in, skilled in, experienced, skilful, clever; active, energetic; joined with, furnished with, endowed with, filled with, possessed of, having, possessing (with inst. or at the end of a comp.); connected with, relating to; proved, inferred, de-duced by argument; (in gram.) primitive, i. e. not derivative; (अम्), ind. collectively, in troops (Ved.); suitably, properly, rightly, fitly, duly, well; (अस्), m. a sage or saint who has become united with the Universal Soul, one who is so absorbed in meditating on the Supreme Spirit as to be free from all feeling and passion; N. of a son of Manu Raivata; of one of the seven Ṛṣis under Manu Bhautya; (आ), f., N. of a plant (commonly called Elāni, cf. युक्त-रसा); (अम्), n. a team, yoke; a measure of four cubits, (incorrectly for 2. युत।) —युक्त-कर्मन्, आ, आ, अ, invested with any office or function, ap-pointed to any work. —युक्त-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, or युक्त-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, doing properly or suitably, acting fitly. —युक्त-ग्रावन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. having the stone (for bruising the Soma) prepared, (Sāy. = उद्यत-ग्रावन्।) —युक्त-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, most fit; most absorbed in or intent on, very much devoted to. —युक्त-तर, अस्, आ, अम्, more fit, very intent on or attentive, very much on one's guard (Manu VII. 186). —युक्त-त्व, अम्, n. application, use, employment; suitableness, fitness, propriety. —युक्त-दण्ड, अस्, आ, अम्, employing or applying punishment; punishing justly. —युक्तदण्ड-ता, f. the inflicting of just punishment. —युक्त-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, ready-minded, fixing the mind, attentive. —युक्त-मांसल, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. properly stout or fleshy. —युक्त-रथ, अस्, m., N. of a particular kind of cleansing clyster; of a sort of elixir. —युक्त-रसा, f. a species of plant (= युक्ता). —युक्त-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, suitably formed, symmetrical, suitable, proper, fit, moderate; fit for, corresponding to (with loc. or gen.); (अम्), ind. suitably. —युक्त-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. containing the verb युज्. —युक्त-शीतोष्ण (°त-उष्°), अस्, आ, अम्, of moderate cold and heat. —युक्त-सेन, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose army is ready (for marching). —युक्तसेनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to one whose army is ready for marching. —युक्ता-यस् (°त-अय्°), अस्, n. ‘bound with iron,’ a sort of spade or shovel. —युक्तायुक्त (°त-अय्°), अम्, n. the proper and improper, right and wrong. —युक्-तारोहिन् (°त-आर्°), ई, इणी, इ, see Pāṇ. VI. 2, 81. —युक्तार्थ (°त-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having mean-ing, filled with significance, sensible, rational, signi-ficant. —युक्ताश्व (°त-अश्°), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. hav-ing yoked horses; consisting of horses, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda V. 41, 5 = अश्व-सहित, ac-companied with horses.)
युग: युग युग, युग्म, युग्य, &c. See p. 818, col. 2, and p. 819, col. 1.

युग, अस्, अम्, m. n. a yoke; (अम्), n. a pair, couple, brace; a double Śloka or two Ślokas so con-nected that the sense is only completed by the two together; a race or generation of men, (generally in Ved. with मानुष or मनुष्य); a period or astronomical cycle of five years, a lustrum, (especially such a period in the cycle of Jupiter); an age of the world, long mundane period of years, (of which there are four, each preceded by a period called सन्ध्या, ‘twilight,’ and followed by a period called सन्ध्यांश, ‘portion of twilight;’ viz. 1. Kṛta or Satya, 2. Tretā, 3. Dvāpara, 4. Kali, of which the first three have already elapsed, while the Kali is that in which we are supposed to live; the first consists of 4000 divine years with 400 for each of its twilights, the second of 3000 with 300 for each twilight, the third of 2000 with 200 for each twilight, the fourth or Kali of 1000 with 100 for each twilight; but since a divine year equals 360 years of men, the four Yugas com-prise severally 1, 728, 000, 1,296,000, 864,000, and 432, 000 years, the aggregate 4,320, 000 con-stituting ‘a great Yuga,’ or महा-युग, q. v.: the regularly descending numbers in the above series represent a corresponding physical and moral deteri-oration in those who live during each age, the present or Kali-yuga being the worst; this last Yuga is sup-posed to have commenced 3101 or 3102 years B.C.); a measure of length (= 4 Hastas or cubits); a sym-bolical expression for the number 4 and sometimes for the number 12; N. of a particular position or configuration of the moon; of a particular Nābhasa constellation (of the class called Saṅkhyā-yoga, when all the planets are situated in two houses); a species of drug or medicinal plant (= वृद्धि); [cf. Gr. ζυγόν; Lat. jugum; Angl. Sax. ioc, iuc, geoc.] —युग-कीलक, अस्, m. the pin of a yoke. —युग-क्षय, अस्, m. the end of a Yuga, destruction of the world. —युग-दीर्घ, अस्, आ, अम्, long as a chariot yoke. —युगन्-धर, अस्, आ, अम्, holding or bearing the yoke; (अस्, अम्), m. n. the pole of a carriage or wood to which the yoke is fixed; (अस्), m., N. of a particular magical formula spoken over weapons; of a king; of a mountain; of a forest; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people. —युग-प, अस्, m., N. of a Gandharva. —युग-पत्त्र or युग-पत्त्रक, अस्, m. mountain ebony, the plant Bauhinia Varie-gata. —युग-पत्त्रिका, f. the plant Dalbergia Sissoo. —युगपत्-प्राप्ति, इस्, f. simultaneous arrival, arriv-ing all together. —युग-पद्, ind. ‘being in the same yoke or by the side of each other,’ together, at one time, at the same time, simultaneously, at once, all at once, all together. —युग-पार्श्वक or युग-पार्श्व-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, going at the side of the yoke (said of a young ox in training). —युग-पुराण, अम्, n., N. of a section of the Garga-saṃ-hitā. —युग-बाहु, उस्, उस्, उ, ‘yoke-armed,’ having arms like a yoke, long armed. —युग-भङ्ग, अस्, m. the breaking of a yoke. —युग-मात्र, अम्, n. the length of a yoke; (अस्, ई, अम्), as large as a yoke. —युग-वरत्र or युग-वरत्रा, see Gaṇa Khaṇḍikādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 45. —युग-व्यायत-बाहु, उस्, उस्, उ, having arms long as a yoke; long armed. —युगांशक (°ग-अं°), अस्, m. ‘part of a Yuga or lustrum,’ a year, (also युगांसक।) —यु-गादि (°ग-आदि), इस्, m. the commencement of a Yuga, the beginning of the world. —युगादि-कृत्, त्, m., N. of Śiva. —युगादि-जिन, अस्, m. the first Jina of a Yuga. —युगादिजिन-श्री, ईस्, m., N. of Ṛṣabha. —युगादीश (°दि-ईश), अस्, m. ‘first lord of a Yuga,’ N. of Ṛṣabha. —युगाद्या (°ग-आद्°), f. the first day of a Yuga or age of the world; the anniversary of it. —युगाध्यक्ष (°ग-अध्°), अस्, m. ‘superintendent of a Yuga,’ epithet of Prajāpati; of Śiva. —युगान्त (°ग-अन्°), अस्, m. the end of the yoke; the meridian, midday, noon; the end of a generation; the end of an age or Yuga, destruc-tion of the world. —युगान्तक, अस्, m. the end of an age, end of the world. —युगान्त-बन्धु, उस्, m. a real and constant friend. —युगान्तर (°ग-अन्°), अम्, n. a kind of yoke, a peculiar yoke; the second half of the arc cutting the meridian described by the sun; another generation, a succeeding age. —युगान्ताग्नि (°त-अग्°), इस्, m. the fire at the end of the world. —युगेश (°ग-ईश), अस्, m., Ved. the lord or ruler of a lustrum. —युगोरस्य (°ग-उर्°), अस्, m., N. of a particular array of troops.

युङ्गिन्: युङ्गिन् युङ्गिन्, ई, m., N. of a particular mixed caste.

युज्: युज् 1. युज् (connected with rt. 2. यु), cl. 7. P. A. युनक्ति, युङ्क्ते (said to be also cl. 1.
