2. युज्, क्, क्, क् (often at the end of comps.; when uncompounded the strong cases ought to have a nasal inserted, e. g. युङ्, युञ्जौ, युञ्जस्, युञ्जम्, युञ्जौ), yoked, joined, connected, joined to, harnessed, drawn by, (चतुर्-युज्, drawn by four horses; अश्व-सहस्र-युज्, drawn by a thousand horses; हयोत्तम-युज्, drawn by the best horses); yoked or joined together, any one who is joined or yoked, a yoke-fellow, yoke-mate, companion; furnished or provided with, filled with, affected by, possessed of, possessing (e. g. प्रीति-युज्, possessing pleasure, pleased; काम-युज्, possessing, i. e. grant-ing desires, cf. धर्म-युज्); exciting, an exciter, (युङ् भियः, exciter of fear); in couples or pairs, even, not odd, not single, not separate [cf. अ-युज्]; (क् or ङ्), m. a pair, couple, the number two; a joiner, one who joins or unites; one who devotes his time to abstract contemplation, a sage; a measure of 300 poles (?); युजौ, m. du. the sign of the zodiac Gemini; the two Aśvins; [cf. Lat. con-jux, con-jug-is.]
युक्ति: युक्ति, इस्, f. yoking, joining, junction, juncture, union, connection, combination; putting to, harness-ing; application, use, employment, practice, usage; appliance, means, plan, scheme, expedient, (द्रव्य-युक्तिभिस्, by the appliances of money); trick, con-trivance, device, stratagem; charm, spell; suitableness, adaptedness, adjustment, fitness, aptness, propriety, correctness; skill, dexterity, ingenuity, art; reasoning, argument, argumentation, inference, induction, deduc-tion from circumstances; probability, provableness; reason, ground, motive; (in the drama) connection of events in the plot, concatenation of incidents, in-telligent weighing of the circumstances; (in gram.) connection of words, a sentence; (in law) enumera-tion of circumstances, specification of place, time, &c.; (in rhetoric) emblematic or mystical expression of purpose; supplying an ellipsis; sum, total; mix-ture or alloying of metals; conjunction (in astro-nomy); युक्त्या, inst. c. by means of, by virtue of (at the end of a comp.); by device or stratagem, cunningly, craftily, cleverly, artfully, skilfully, under pretext or pretence; properly, suitably, fitly, duly; युक्तिं कृ, to make arrangements, take measures; to find a means, discover a remedy; to employ stratagem. —युक्ति-कथन, अम्, n. statement of argument, giving reasons. —युक्ति-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, causing fitness, suitable, proper, fit; established, proved. —युक्ति-कल्प-तरु, उस्, m. [cf. कल्प-तरु], ‘Kalpa tree of prosperity,’ N. of a work ascribed to king Bhoja (describing the virtues and good qualities that ought to be found in a king's ministers, army, &c.). —युक्ति-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, knowing the proper application, knowing the means or remedy; skilled in mixing (substances). —युक्ति-तस्, ind. by means of, by virtue of (at the end of a comp.); by stratagem or craft, craftily, cleverly, artfully, under some pretence or pretext; in a suitable manner, properly, fitly, duly, according to propriety or justice. —युक्ति-भाषा, f., N. of a work. —युक्-ति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, joined, united, tied; possessing fitness, full of contrivances or plans, fertile in expe-dients, ingenious, clever, inventive, able, competent; furnished with arguments, based on argument, proved. —युक्तिमत्-त्व, अम्, n. the being based on argu-ment, the being proved. —युक्ति-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, possessing fitness or aptness, experienced, expert, skilful; possessing fitness or reason, suitable, proper, fit; established, proved. —युक्ति-शास्त्र, अम्, n. the science of what is suitable or proper. —युक्ति-स्नेह-प्रपूरणी, f., N. of a commentary on the Śāstra-dīpikā by Rāma-kṛṣṇa Bhaṭṭa, (the work is also called Siddhānta-candrikā.)
युक्त्वा: युक्त्वा, ind. having yoked, having joined, having harnessed; having equipped or furnished; (a form युङ्क्त्वा is also found.)
युगल: युगल, अम्, n. a pair, couple, brace, (उपानद्-युगलम्, a pair of shoes; कण्ठ-निवेशित-हस्त-युगला, having both her hands applied to her neck); ‘double prayer,’ N. of a prayer offered up to Lakṣmī and Nārāyaṇa. —युगल-भक्त, आस्, m. pl., N. of a subdivision of the Caitanya Vaiṣṇavas. —युगलाख्य (°ल-आख्°), अस्, m. a species of plant.
युगलक: युगलक, अम्, n. a pair, couple, brace; a couple of Ślokas or two verses so connected that the sense is only completed by the two together.
युगलाय: युगलाय, Nom. A. युगलायते, &c., to be like or represent a pair (of anything).
युगलायित: युगलायित, अस्, आ, अम्, representing or like a pair.
युगाय: युगाय, Nom. A. युगायते, &c., to appear as long as a Yuga, to seem like eternity.
युग्म: युग्म, अस्, आ, अम्, even [cf. अ-य्°]; (अम्), n. a pair, couple, brace; twins; the sign of the zodiac Gemini; a couple of Ślokas or two verses so con-nected that the sense is only completed by the two together; junction, union, mixing, uniting; conflu-ence (of two streams). —युग्म-ज, औ, m. du. twins. —युग्म-पत्त्र, अस्, m. mountain ebony, Bauhinia Variegata (= युग-पत्त्र). —युग्म-पत्त्रिका, f. Dalbergia Sissoo (= युग-पत्त्रिका)। —युग्म-पर्ण, अस्, m. Bauhinia Variegata; Al-stonia Scholaris. —युग्म-फला, f., N. of various plants (= इन्द्र-चिर्बिटी, वृश्चिकाली, गन्धिका)। —युग्म-फलोत्तम (°ल-उत्°), अस्, m. Asclepias Rosea. —युग्म-विपुला, f. a species of metre.
युग्मक: युग्मक, अस्, आ, अम्, even; (अम्), n. a pair, couple, brace; a couple of Ślokas or verses connected by the construction of the sentence (the sense being completed only by the two together).
युग्मन्: युग्मन्, आ, आ, अ, or युग्मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. even.
युग्मिन्: युग्मिन्, ई, इनी, इ, an adj. fr. युग्म।
युग्य: युग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, fit or proper to be yoked or harnessed; belonging to a yoke; yoked, harnessed; drawn by (e. g. अश्व-युग्य, drawn by horses); any yoked or draught animal; (अम्), n. a vehicle, car-riage, car, chariot; जमदग्नेर् व्रतं युग्यम्, N. of a Sāman. —युग्य-वाह, अस्, m. a coachman, driver. —युग्य-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, being in a car-riage, a person in a carriage.
युज: युज = 2. युज्, ‘even,’ ‘not odd,’ in a few comps.
युज्य: युज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. connected, united, friendly; related, allied; suitable, fit, fitting, proper; of the same kind, homogeneous; a kinsman; (अम्), n. union, connection, relationship; जमदग्नेर् व्रतं युज्-यम्, N. of a Sāman, (also read युग्यम्।)
युज्यमान: युज्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being united or joined or connected with (with inst.); being furnished or provided with, possessing (with inst.).
युञ्जक: युञ्जक, अस्, आ, अम्, applying, performing, exer-cising, practising, (ध्यान-युञ्जक, practising devotion.)
युञ्जत्: युञ्जत्, अन्, अती, अत्, uniting, joining; uniting spi-ritually, practising devotion.
युञ्जान: युञ्जान, अस्, आ, अम्, uniting, combining, joining with; suitable, fitting, proper; successful, prosperous; (अस्), m. a driver, coachman, charioteer; a Brāhman, one who by the religious exercise called Yoga endea-vours to obtain union with the Supreme Soul.
युञ्जानक: युञ्जानक, अस्, आ, अम्, containing the word युञ्जान।
युयुक्षमाण: युयुक्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Desid.), wish-ing to join or unite; wishing to effect spiritual union (with the divine essence), devout.
युयुजान: युयुजान, अस्, आ, अम् (Perf. Part. A.), one who has yoked or joined. —युयुजान-सप्ति, ई, m. du., Ved. having harnessed or yoked their horses (said of the two Aśvins; Sāy. = रथे युज्यमानाश्वौ).
योक्तव्य: योक्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be yoked or joined or united, to be united (spiritually); to be applied or made use of, applicable, practicable; to be appointed to (any office), to be charged with (with loc., e. g. कर्मणि योक्तव्यः, to be charged with a business); to be fixed on or directed to (as the mind); to be furnished or endowed with, to be made to be pos-sessed of (with inst.).
योक्तव्य योक्तव्य, योक्तृ, योक्त्र, &c. See p. 819, col. 2.
योक्तृ: योक्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who yokes or harnesses, a harnesser, driver, coachman; an exciter, rouser.
योक्त्र: योक्त्र, अम्, n. any instrument for tying or fas-tening, a tie, fastening, band, cord, halter, rope, thong, girth; the tie of the yoke of a plough; the thongs by which an animal is attached to the pole of a vehicle.
योक्त्रय: योक्त्रय (fr. योक्त्र), Nom. P. योक्त्रयति, &c., to tie, bind, fasten, wind round.
योग: योग, योग्य, &c. See p. 821, col. 2, and p. 823, col. 2.

योग योग, अस्, m. (in one or two excep-tional cases अम्, n.; fr. rt. 1. युज्), the act of yoking, joining, junction, conjunction, uniting, union, con-tact; the harnessing or putting to (of horses); a yoke, team, (षड्-योग, having a team of six); convey-ance; the arraying or equipping (of an army), arrangement, disposition; applying, fixing, application, use, employment, appointment, institution; the put-ting on armour; armour; the fixing (of an arrow or other weapon); application of a remedy or medicine, remedy, cure; mode, manner, method, means, (यो-गेन or योगात् at the end of comps. = ‘by means of,’ ‘by reason of,’ ‘through’); an expedient, artifice, plan, device, (योगेन, artfully, craftily); a super-natural means, charm, incantation, spell, magic, magical art; fraud, deceit [cf. योग-नन्द]; side, part, argument; occasion, opportunity; fitness, pro-priety, suitability, aptness, congruity, (योगेन, suit-ably, fitly, in accordance with, conformably to); the performance or execution (of anything); undertaking, occupation, work, business; gaining, acquiring, ac-quisition [cf. योग-क्षेम]; accession of property, substance, wealth, thing; connection, consequence, result, (योगात् at the end of comps. = ‘in consequence of,’ e. g. कर्म-योगात्, in consequence of actions, i. e. of destiny); combination or mixing of various materials, association, mixture; contact, (with Jainas) contact or mixing with the outer world; (in the Sāṅkhya phil.) one of the ten Mūlikārthas; con-nection with, the partaking or possessing of (with inst.); conjunction (in astronomy, cf. नक्षत्र-योग), lucky conjuncture; (in arithmetic) addition, sum, total; the being connected together, depend-ance, relation, regular order or series, (कथा-योग, conversation); a period of time, (काल-योगेन, after the lapse of some time; नव-योग, nine times); a combination or configuration of stars, a constella-tion, asterism, (these with the moon are called in astronomical works चान्द्र-योगाः, and are thirteen in number; without the moon they are called ख-योगाः or नाभस-योगाः, and are divided into आकृति-योगाः, सङ्ख्या-योगाः, आश्रय-योगाः, and दल-योगाः; two others are added, called द्विग्रह-योगाः); (in astronomy) N. of a particular division of time or astronomical period, (a period of variable length during which the joint motion in longitude of the sun and moon amounts to 30° 204; the term योग in this sense is a mere mode of indicating the sum of the longitude of the sun and moon; twenty-seven such Yogas are enumerated, beginning with 1. Viṣkambha, and ending with 27. Vaidhṛti, or according to some authorities twenty-eight); the leading or principal star of a lunar mansion; etymo-logy, derivation of the meaning of a word from its root; the etymological meaning of a word (opposed to रूढि); (in gram.) the connection of words together, dependence of one word upon another, construction; a rule, aphorism, precept [cf. योग-विभाग]; application of effort, endeavour, diligence, assiduity, zeal, attention, (पूर्णेन योगेन or जल-पूर्णेन योगेन, with all one's powers, with over-flowing zeal); application or concentration of the thoughts, fixing the mind on a particular point and keeping the body in a fixed posture, abstract con-templation, meditation; the systematic practice of the above abstract contemplation or meditation; the Yoga system of philosophy as established by Patañjali, (the Yoga is the name of the second of the two divisions of the Sāṅkhya system, its chief aim being to teach the means by which the human soul may attain complete union with Īśvara or the Supreme Being, whose existence it establishes, while the origi-nal system or Sāṅkhya proper, without acknowledging a Supreme Being, teaches the successive development of the Tattvas or principles of creation from an origi-nal Tattva, called Prakṛti or Pradhāna; according to Patañjali, the author of the second system, Yoga is defined to be ‘the preventing of the modifications of चित्त or the thinking principle [which modifica-tions arise through the three Pramāṇas, perception, inference, and verbal testimony, as well as through incorrect ascertainment, fancy, sleep, and recollection] by अभ्यास or the constant practice of keeping the mind in its unmodified state [clear as crystal when uncoloured by contact with other substances], and by वैराग्य or dispassion;’ this dispassion being ob-tained by प्रणिधान or devotedness to Īśvara, the Supreme, who is defined as a particular Puruṣa or spirit unaffected by afflictions, works, &c., and having the appellation Praṇava or Om, which mono-syllable is to be muttered and its meaning reflected on in order to attain knowledge of the Supreme and the prevention of the obstacles to Yoga: the eight means or stages of Yoga or mental concentration are, 1. यम, forbearance; 2. नियम, religious ob-servances; 3. आसन, postures; 4. प्राणायाम, regu-lation of the breath; 5. प्रत्याहार, restraint of the senses; 6. धारणा, steadying of the mind; 7. ध्या-न, contemplation; 8. समाधि, profound medita-tion, which, according to the Bhagavad-gītā VI. 13, is to be practised by fixing the eyes on the tip of the nose: true liberation is the cessation of all idea of self and the separation of matter and spirit or कैवल्य, isolation: the self-mortification and asce-ticism of the Yoga connects it closely with Buddhism); the union of the individual soul with the universal soul, devotion, pious seeking after God; any single act or rite conducive to Yoga or abstract contem-plation; (personified as) the son of Dharma and Kriyā; a follower of the Yoga system of philosophy; a traitor, violator of confidence, spy; N. of a com-mentator on the Paramārtha-sāra; (आ), f., N. of Pīvarī (daughter of the Pitṛs called Barhiṣads); of a Śakti. —योग-कक्षा, f. = योग-पट्ट. —योग-कन्या, f., N. of the infant daughter of Yaśo-dā (substituted as the child of Devakī for the infant Kṛṣṇa and therefore killed by Kaṃsa, but imme-diately raised to heaven as a beautiful girl; as she ascended she warned Kaṃsa of his doom, see Hari-vaṃśa 3340). —योग-करण्डक, अस्, m., N. of a minister of Brahma-datta; (इका), f., N. of a female ascetic (प्रव्राजिका). —योग-कुण्डलिनी, f., N. of an Upaniṣad. —योग-क्षेम, अस्, m. the security or secure possession of what has been acquired, the keeping safe of property; योजन: योजन, योजयितृ, योजितृ, योज्य, &c. See p. 823, cols. 2, 3.

योजन, अम्, n. the act of joining, junction, har-nessing, yoking; that which is yoked or harnessed (as ‘a yoke of oxen,’ ‘pair or team of horses,’ ‘a vehicle or its trappings;’ so explained by some in Ṛg-veda VI. 62, 6, &c., but in Ṛg-veda I. 88, 5. योजनम् is explained to mean ‘a means for inducing the gods to yoke their horses,’ i. e. a hymn); a stage or distance gone in one harnessing or without un-yoking; a particular measure of distance sometimes regarded as about equal to an European league (i. e. 4 or 5 English miles, but more correctly = 4 Krośas or about 9 miles; according to other calculations = 2(1/2) English miles, and according to some = 8 Krośas); a way, course, road (Ved.); a line, row (Ved.?); the act of applying, application, fixing, arranging, preparing, preparation, (आहार-य्°, preparation of food); erecting, constructing, (in these senses some-times आ, f.); application of the sense of a passage, the putting together of the sense, construction (in gram.); application of effort, exertion (Ved., Sāy. = उद्योग); the act of inciting or exciting, instigation; application of the thoughts, concentration of the mind, abstraction, directing the thoughts to one point (= योग); the Supreme Being or Soul of the Universe; (आ), f. union, connection; grammatical construction. —योजन-गन्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, whose scent or fragrance extends for a Yojana, diffusing perfume to the distance of a Yojana; (आ), f. musk; epithet of Satya-vatī the mother of Vyāsa; of Sītā. —योजन-गन्धिका, f. epithet of Satya-vatī. —यो-जन-पर्णी, f. Bengal madder, Rubia Munjista (= मञ्जिष्ठा). —योजन-वल्लिका or योजन-वल्ली, f. = योजन-पर्णी, col. 2. —योजन-शत, अम्, n. a hundred Yojanas.
युञ्जन्द: युञ्जन्द युञ्जन्द, N. of a place.
युत्कार: युत्कार युत्-कार, युद्-भू। See under 2. युध्, col. 3.
युद्ध: युद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, fought, encountered; over-come, subdued, conquered; (अम्), n. war, battle, conflict, fight, combat, struggle, contest, strife, en-gagement; (in astronomy) opposition, conflict of the planets. —युद्ध-काण्ड, अम्, n. ‘battle-section,’ N. of the sixth book of Vālmīki's Rāmāyaṇa; of the sixth book of the Adhyātma-rāmāyaṇa. —युद्-धकारि-त्व, अम्, n. making war, fighting. —युद्-ध-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, making war, fighting, con-tending, struggling, engaging in battle. —युद्ध-कीर्त्ति, इस्, m., N. of a pupil of Śaṅkarācārya. —युद्ध-गान्धर्व, अम्, n. a battle like the dance of the Gandharvas. —युद्ध-जयार्णव (°य-अर्°), अस्, m., N. of a section of the Jyotiḥ-śāstra. —युद्ध-जयोपाय (°य-उप्°), अस्, m., N. of a work. —युद्ध-जित्, त्, त्, त्, victorious in battle. —युद्ध-द्यूत, अम्, n. the game of war, luck of battle, chance of war, (see द्यूत।) —युद्ध-धर्म, अस्, m. the law of war. —युद्ध-पराङ्-मुख, अस्, ई, अम्, averse from fighting. —युद्ध-पुरी, f., N. of a town. —युद्ध-भू, ऊस्, or युद्ध-भूमि, इस्, f. battle-ground, a field of battle. —युद्ध-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of war, re-sulting from battle, relating to war, warlike, martial. —युद्ध-मार्ग, अस्, m. a mode of fighting, stratagem, manœuvre. —युद्ध-मुष्टि, इस्, m., N. of a son of Ugra-sena. —युद्ध-मेदिनी, f. battle-ground, a field of battle. —युद्ध-योजक, अस्, आ, अम्, preparing for war, eager for battle. —युद्ध-रङ्ग, अस्, m. ‘battle-arena,’ field of battle; (अस्, आ, अम्), whose arena is battle; (अस्), m., N. of Kārttikeya. —युद्ध-वस्तु, उ, n. an implement of war. —युद्ध-विद्या, f. the science of war, military art. —युद्ध-वीर, अस्, m. ‘battle-hero,’ a valiant man, warrior, hero, champion; he-roism, bravery (as one of the Rasas). —युद्ध-शक्ति, इस्, f. warlike vigour or prowess. —युद्ध-शालिन्, ई, इनी, इ, warlike, courageous, valiant, bold. —युद्ध-सार, अस्, m. ‘battle-goer,’ a horse. —युद्धाचार्य (°ध-आच्°), अस्, m. ‘war-pre-ceptor,’ a military instructor, one who teaches the use of arms. —युद्धाजि (°ध-आजि), इस्, m., N. of a descendant of Aṅgiras. —युद्धाध्वन् (°ध-अध्°), आ, आ, अ, going or resorting to battle. —युद्-धार्थिन् (°ध-अर्°), ई, इनी, इ, desirous of war, seeking war. —युद्धावसान (°ध-अव्°), अम्, n. cessation of war, truce. —युद्धोद्यम (°ध-उद्°), or युद्धोद्योग (°ध-उद्°), अस्, m. pre-paring for battle, vigorous and active preparation for war. —युद्धोन्मत्त (°ध-उन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘battle-mad,’ fierce or frantic in battle; (अस्), m., N. of a Rākṣasa. —युद्धोपकरण (°ध-उप्°), अम्, n. a war implement, accoutrements.
युध्: युध् 1. युध्, cl. 4. A. P. (in Post-Vedic literature usually A. except where the metre requires P.) युध्यते (-ति), युयुधे (3rd pl. P. युयुधुः), योत्स्यते (योत्स्यति), अयुद्ध (अयो-धीत्), योद्धुम् (Ved. Inf. युधये), to fight, combat, oppose in battle (with acc.); to overcome in battle, conquer, vanquish (with acc.); to fight or contend with (with inst. or inst. with सह, e. g. शत्रुभिः or शत्रुभिः सह युध्यते, he fights with enemies); to fight for or about (with loc., Ved.); to wage war, fight, engage in battle or war; (according to Naigh. II. 14) to go (P.): Pass. यु-ध्यते, to be fought: Caus. P. योधयति (rarely A. -ते), -यितुम्, Aor. अयूयुधत्, to cause to fight, make to fight with (with inst.); to order to fight; to make war upon, attack, fight against, oppose; to overcome in battle, vanquish, conquer; to defend: Pass. of Caus. योध्यते, to be made to fight, &c.: Desid. युयुत्सति, -ते (in ep. often P. on account of the metre), to be desirous or anxious to fight; to wish to conquer; to prepare to fight: Caus. of Desid. युयुत्सयति, to make desirous of fighting, make eager for battle: Intens. योयुध्यते, योयोद्-धि; [cf. Zend yud: Gr. ὑσ-μλιην, ὑσ-μίν: Hib. iodhna, ‘spears, arms’ (= आ-युध); iodnach, ‘valiant;’ iodhlan, ‘a hero:’ (perhaps also) Angl. Sax. gudh: (perhaps) Old Germ. gund, ‘battle.’]

2. युध्, त्, त्, त्, warring, fighting; a fighter, war-rior, soldier, hero, champion; (त्), f. war, fight, battle, combat, conflict, struggle, contest. —युत्-कार, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. making war, waging war, fighting, contending. —युद्-भू, ऊस्, f. battle-ground, a field of battle. —युधा-जित्, त्, त्, त् (युधा, inst. c.), conquering or vanquishing by means of war; (त्), m., N. of a son of Kroṣṭu by a woman called Mādrī; of a son of Kekaya (uncle of Bharata); of a son of Vṛṣṇi; of a king of Ujjayinī. —युधा-मन्यु, उस्, m. (युधा, inst. c.), N. of a warrior on the side of the Pāṇḍavas. —युधि-श्रेष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम्, pre-eminent in battle. —युधि-ष्ठिर, अस्, m. (युधि, loc. c. + स्थिर), ‘firm or steady in battle,’ N. of the eldest of the five reputed sons of Pāṇḍu, (though nominally the son of Pāṇḍu, he was really the child of Pṛthā or Kuntī, Pāṇḍu's wife, by the god Dharma or Yama, whence he is often called Dharma-putra or Dharma-rāja; as the eldest of the five Pāṇḍavas, he ultimately succeeded Pāṇḍu as king, first reigning over Indra-prastha, and after-wards, when the Kuru princes or sons of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra were defeated, at Hāstina-pura); N. of a son of Kṛṣṇa; of two kings of Kaśmīra; of a potter (in Pañca-tantra, p. 217); of a preceptor; (आस्), m. pl. the descendants of Yudhi-ṣṭhira, son of Pāṇḍu. —युधिष्ठिर-पुरोगम, अस्, आ, अम्, having Yudhi-ṣṭhira as leader, led on by Yudhi-ṣṭhira.
युद्धक: युद्धक, अम्, n. = युद्ध, war, battle, &c.
युद्धिन्: युद्धिन्, ई, इनी, इ, relating to war or battle, &c.
युधांश्रौष्टि: युधांश्रौष्टि, इस्, m., Ved. a proper N.
युधाजीव: युधाजीव, अस्, m. a proper N., (perhaps for युद्धाजीव।)
युधान: युधान, अस्, m. a man of the second or military order, a warrior; an enemy.
युधासुर: युधासुर, अस्, m., N. of king Nanda.
युधि: युधि, Ved. fighting, contending, battle, (usually occurring in the dat. युधये used as a Ved. Inf. in the sense ‘to fight.’)
युधिक: युधिक, अस्, आ, अम्, fighting, contending, (per-haps an incorrect form.)
युधिङ्गम: युधिङ्-गम, अस्, आ, अम् (युधिम्, acc. c.), Ved. going to battle.
युधेन्य: युधेन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be fought with, to be overcome in battle.
युध्म: युध्म, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. warlike, material; (अस्), m. a warrior, champion, soldier, (Sāy. = योद्धृ); a battle, fight; an arrow; a bow; (according to some) = शेष-सङ्ग्राम; = शरभ।
युध्य: युध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be fought with; to be conquered or subdued, conquerable.
युध्यमान: युध्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, fighting, making war.
युध्यामधि: युध्यामधि, इस्, m., Ved. a proper N.
युध्वन्: युध्वन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. warlike, martial, a warrior.
युयुत्सत्: युयुत्सत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, wishing to fight.
युयुत्सा: युयुत्सा, f. (fr. the Desid.), the wishing to fight, desire for war, eagerness for battle, pugnacity, enmity. —युयुत्सा-रहित, अस्, आ, अम्, without wish or in-tention to fight, cowardly.
युयुत्सा युयुत्सा, युयुत्सु, युयुधान, &c. See col. 1.
युयुत्सु: युयुत्सु, उस्, उस्, उ, wishing to fight, desiring war, eager for battle; anxious to fight with (with inst. or with सह, सार्धम्, &c. with inst.); pug-nacious, hostile, ambitious; (उस्), m. a combatant; N. of one of the sons of Dhṛta-rāṣṭra.
युयुधन्: युयुधन्, आ, m., N. of a king of Mithilā.
युयुधान: युयुधान, अस्, m., N. of a son of Satyaka, (he was one of the allies of the Pāṇḍavas); a Kṣatriya, warrior; epithet of Indra.
युयुधि: युयुधि or यूयुधि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. warlike, martial, pugnacious.
योत्स्यमान: योत्स्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, about to fight, ready to fight.
योद्धव्य: योद्धव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be fought or contended, to be overcome in battle, (the neuter may be used impersonally, e. g. कैर् मया सह योद्धव्यम्, by whom is it to be fought with me.)
योद्धव्य योद्धव्य, योद्धृ, योध, योधिन्, &c. See p. 820, col. 1.
योद्धुकाम: योद्धु-काम, अस्, आ, अम्, wishing to fight, anxious for battle.
योद्धृ: योद्धृ, धा, m. a fighter, warrior, champion, combatant, soldier.
योध: योध, अस्, m. a fighter, warrior, champion, com-batant, soldier; battle, war (in दुर्-य्°, मिथो-य्°, q. q. v. v.); a kind of metre, four times ¯˘¯¯˘¯. —योध-धर्म, अस्, m. the law of soldiers, military law, duty of the Kṣatriya caste. —योध-मुख्य, अस्, m. a chief warrior, leader. —योध-वीर, अस्, m. a hero, warrior. —योध-संराव, अस्, m. challenging to battle, mutual defiance of combatants. —योध-हर, अस्, आ, अम्, carrying warriors. —योधागार (°ध-आग्°), अस्, m. a soldier's dwelling, barrack.
योधक: योधक, अस्, m. = योध, a fighter, warrior.
योधन: योधन, अम्, n. the act of fighting, battle, war, strife. —योधन-पुर-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.
योधनीपुर: योधनी-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town.
योधयत्: योधयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, fighting, making war.
योधिक: योधिक, epithet of a particular mode of fighting; [cf. यौधिक।]
योधिन्: योधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, fighting, contending, waging war, (at the end of comps., e. g. दिव्यास्त्र-योधिन्, fighting with divine weapons; cf. हय-य्°); con-quering, subduing, a conqueror (e. g. दानव-योधिन्, conquering the Dānavas); (ई), m. a warrior. —योधि-वन, अम्, n., N. of a place.
योधीयस्: योधीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. of योध), more warlike or martial.
योधेय: योधेय, अस्, m. = योध, a warrior, combatant; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a race.
योध्य: योध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be fought, to be overcome in battle, to be conquered or subdued, conquerable; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people.
युन्थ्: युन्थ् युन्थ् = rt. पुन्थ्, q. v.
युप्: युप् युप्, cl. 4. P. युप्यति, युयोप, अयु-पत्, &c., to confuse, trouble, perplex; to efface, destroy, obliterate; to make level or smooth; to be concealed, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 104, 4. युयोप = गूढम् आसीत्): Caus. योपयति, यितुम्, to efface, obliterate, destroy: Intens. यो-युप्यते।
योपन: योपन, अम्, n. the act of effacing (foot-prints or traces, &c.) or anything used for effacing or obli-terating; the act of oppressing, obstructing, molest-ing, perplexing, confusing, destroying, effacing, obli-terating (sometimes at the end of comps.; cf. पद-य्°, जन-य्°).
योपन योपन। See under rt. युप्, p. 820.
योपयत्: योपयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, effacing, obliterating, obstructing, perplexing.
युयु: युयु युयु, उस्, m. a horse, (probably incor-rect for ययु।)
युयुक्खुर: युयुक्खुर युयुक्-खुर, अस्, m. a hyena.
युयुवि: युयुवि युयुवि। See यूयुवि, p. 821, col. 2.
युव: युव युव, the actual base of the dual of the second personal pronoun, (युवाम्, nom. acc. you two; युवाभ्याम्, inst. dat. abl.; युवयोस्, gen. loc.; Ved. forms युवम्, युवभ्याम्, युवोस्।) —युव-द्रिक्, ind., Ved. directed towards both of you. —युव-धित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. placed or arranged for you both; beneficial to you both, (Sāy. युवा-भ्यां विहित।) —युवा-दत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. given by both of you. —युवा-नीत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. brought by both of you. —युवा-युज्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. yoked for you both, harnessed by you both. —युवा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. belonging to both of you.
युवत्: 1. युवत् (for 2. युवत् see col. 3), Ved. abl. du. of the 2nd personal pronoun, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 109, 1. युवत् = युवाभ्याम्।) —युवद्-देवत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having (each of) you for a divinity.
2. युवत्, Ved. = युवन्, youthful, Ṛg-veda X. 39, 8. (For 1. युवत् see col. 2.)
युवयु: युवयु or युवायु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. longing for both of you, (Sāy. युवयु = युवां कामयमा-न); intended for you both.
युवाकु: युवाकु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. belonging to both of you.
युवक: युवक, अस्, m. = युवन्, a youth.
युवन्: युवन् युवन्, आ, युवति or युवती or यूनी, अ (said to be fr. rt. 2. यु, but according to some for द्युवन्, fr. 3. द्यु or rt. 2. दिव्, ‘to shine;’ com-par. यवीयस्, q. v.; superl. यविष्ठ, q. v.), young, youthful, juvenile, adult, arrived at puberty (applied to men or animals); endowed with native or natural strength, strong, excellent, good, healthy; (आ), m. a youth, young man, a young animal; (in the Veda युवन् is also applied to Indra, Agni, and various other gods); the younger descendant of any one (an elder descendant being still alive); N. of the ninth year in Jupiter's cycle of sixty years; (युवति, इस्), f. a girl, young woman, any youthful female, any young female animal, (इभ-युवति, a young female elephant; the term युवति is also applied in the Veda to Uṣas, Night and Morning, Heaven and Earth); turmeric; (युवती), f. = युवति, a young woman; the sign of the zodiac Virgo; [cf. Lat. juveni-s, jun-ior, Junius, junix: Goth. juggs: Angl. Sax. iong, iung, geong, geogudh: Lith. jauna-s: Slav. junu, ‘a youth;’ junosti, ‘youth.’] —युव-खलति, इस्, इस्, इ, bald in youth; युव-खलती, f. bald in girlhood. —युव-गण्ड, अस्, m. an eruption on the face of young people. —युव-जरत्, अन्, अती, अत्, appearing old in youth, becoming old at an early age. —युव-जानि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. having a young wife. —युव-ता, f. or युव-त्व, अम्, n. youthfulness, youth. —युवति-जन or यु-वती-जन, अस्, m. a young woman. —युवतीष्टा (°ति-इष्°), f. yellow jasmine (= स्वर्ण-यूथिका)। —युव-पलित, अस्, आ (?), अम्, grey-haired in youth. —युव-प्रत्यय, अस्, m. a suffix forming the so-called Yuvan patronymics. —युव-मारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. dying in youth. —युव-राज, अस्, m. ‘young king,’ an heir-apparent associated with the reigning sovereign in the government, a crown prince; epithet of Maitreya the future Buddha; one of the Jaina Pontiffs. —युवराज-त्व or युव-राज्य, अम्, n. the rank or position of an heir-apparent to a throne. —युव-राजन्, आ, m. = युव-राज above. —युव-राज-शब्द-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, possessing the title of heir-apparent. —युव-वलिन, अस्, आ, अम्, having wrinkles in youth or at an early age. —युवी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to become young. —युवी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become young.
युवति: युवति or युवती। See under युवन्, col. 2.
युवन्यु: युवन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. youthful, juvenile.
युवश: युवश, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. young, youthful, juvenile.
युवन: युवन युवन (?), अस्, m. the moon.
युवनाश्व: युवनाश्व युवनाश्व, अस्, m., N. of the father of Māndhātṛ; of various persons. —युव-नाश्व-ज, अस्, m. the son of Yuvanāśva, i. e. Mān-dhātṛ (an early sovereign of the solar dynasty).
युवा: युवा युवा, f., Ved., N. of one of Agni's arrows.
युवादत्त: युवादत्त युवा-दत्त, युवायु, &c. See under युव, col. 2.
युवाम: युवाम युवाम, N. of a town.
युष्टग्राम: युष्टग्राम युष्ट-ग्राम, अस्, m., N. of a village.
युस्मद्: युस्मद् युष्मद्, a form derived from युष्-मत्, abl. pl. of the pronominal base 4. यु, and serving for the base of the 2nd personal pronoun in the plural number and at the beginning of some compounds; the actual base, however, in most of the plural cases is युष्म, which is also found in a few compounds, cf. युष्मा-दत्त below; the fol-lowing forms are found, यूयम्, nom. pl. you; युष्मान्, acc. you; युष्माभिस्, inst. by you; युष्मभ्यम्, dat. to you; युष्मत् or युष्मत्-तस्, abl. from you; युष्माकम्, gen. of you, (in Ved. the final nasal may be dropped, e. g. युष्मा-कैक for युष्माकम् एक); युष्मासु (Ved. also युष्मे), loc. in you, cf. Ṛg-veda VIII. 47, 8; [cf. Zend yūs; Gr. ὑμεῖς, Æol. ὔμμες (fr. ὔσμες); Goth. and Lith. ju-s.] —युष्मद्-अर्थम्, ind. for you, on your account. —युष्मद्-आयत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, dependent upon you, at your disposal. —युष्मद्-वाच्य, अम्, n. (in gram.) the second person. —युष्मद्-विध, अस्, आ, अम्, of your kind or sort, like you. —युष्मा-दत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. given or bestowed by you; [cf. युवा-दत्त।] —युष्मा-दृश्, क्, क्, क्, or युष्मा-दृश, अस्, ई, अम्, like you, similar to you, resembling you, one such as you; [cf. मादृश्, त्वा-दृश्।] —युष्मा-नीत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. led or accompanied by you. —युष्मा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. belonging to you. —युष्मेषित (°मा-इष्°), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. excited or instigated by you. —युष्मोत (°मा-ऊत), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. protected or loved by you.
युष्मदीय: युष्मदीय, अस्, आ, अम्, your, yours, your own, belonging to you.
युष्मयत्: युष्मयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, Ved. seeking you, addressed to you, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda II. 39, 7 = युवाम् इच्छत्।)
युष्माक: युष्माक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. your, yours; [cf. युष्माक under युष्मद्।]
यू: यू यू, ऊस्, m. (according to some f.), soup, pease-soup, broth (= यूष).
यूक: यूक यूक, अस्, आ, m. f. (said to be fr. rt. 2. यु), a louse. —यूक-देवी, f., N. of a princess. —यूका-लिक्ष, अम्, n. lice and nits.
यूकर: यूकर यूकर, see Gaṇa Kṛśāśvādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80.
यूति: यूति यूति, इस्, f. (fr. rt. 2. यु), joining, mixing, mixture, junction, connection, union, addi-tion; [cf. युति, वहिर्-यूति।]
यूथ: यूथ यूथ, अस्, अम्, m. n. (usually अम्, n.; fr. rt. 2. यु), a flock, herd (of birds, animals, &c.); a bevy, troop, band; a multitude, number, large quantity; (ई), f. a kind of jasmine (= यूथिका)। —यूथ-ग, अस्, m., N. of a class of gods under Manu Cākṣuṣa. —यूथ-नाथ, अस्, m. the lord of a band, leader of a troop, head of a flock or herd; a large elephant. —यूथ-प, अस्, or यूथ-पति, इस्, m. a keeper or protector of a troop, lord or captain of a band; the leader of a herd (especially of elephants), a large elephant. —यूथपति-सका-शम्, ind. to the chief of the herd. —यूथ-परि-भ्रष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, fallen out or strayed from the herd. —यूथ-पशु, उस्, m., N. of a particular tax or tithe. —यूथ-पाल, अस्, m. = यूथ-प. —यू-थ-भ्रष्ट or यूथ-विभ्रष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, = यूथ-परिभ्रष्ट above. —यूथ-मुख्य, अस्, m. the chief or captain of a troop. —यूथ-शस्, ind. in troops or bands, in flocks or herds, gregariously. —यूथ-हत, अस्, आ, अम्, = यूथ-परिभ्रष्ट। —यूथाग्रणी (°थ-अग्°), ईस्, m. a leader of a band or troop. —यूथी-कृ, cl. 8. P. -करोति, &c., to make or form into a herd, to unite in a flock.
यूथक: यूथक at the end of an adj. comp. = यूथ।
यूथर: यूथर, an adj. fr. यूथ, see Gaṇa Aśmādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80.
यूथिका: यूथिका, f. a kind of jasmine, Jasminum Auricu-latum; globe-amaranth; Clypea Hernandifolia.
यूथ्य: यूथ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging to a herd or flock; being at the head of the herd; belonging to a troop or herd of (at the end of a comp.).
यून: यून यून, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 2. यु), a band, cord, string.
यूनि: यूनि, इस्, f. joining, connection, union.
यूनर्वन्: यूनर्वन् यूनर्वन्, a Vedic word of which the sense is doubtful.
यूनी: यूनी यूनी, f. of युवन्, q. v.
यूप: यूप यूप, अस्, m. (according to Uṇādi-s. III. 27. fr. rt. 2. यु, ‘to bind;’ but according to some, more probably fr. rt. युप्), a smooth post or stake to which the sacrificial victim is fastened, any sacrificial post, (usually made of bamboos or Khadira wood; in Rāmāyaṇa I. 13, 24, 25, where the horse sacrifice is described, twenty-one of these posts are set up, six made of Vilva, six of Khadira, six of Palāśa, one of Uḍumbara, one of Śleṣmātaka, and one of Deva-dāru); a column erected in honour of a victory, a trophy (= जय-स्तम्भ); N. of a par-ticular conjunction of the class आकृति-योग (i. e. when all the planets are situated in the first, second, third, and fourth houses). —यूप-कटक, अस्, m. a wooden ring at the top of the sacrificial post; (ac-cording to some) an iron ring at its base. —यूप-कर्ण, अस्, m. the part of a sacrificial post which is sprinkled with ghee. —यूप-केतु, उस्, m., N. of Bhūri-śravas. —यूप-च्छेदन, अम्, n. the cutting of the sacrificial post. —यूप-दारु, n. the wood for the sacrificial post. —यूप-द्रु, उस्, m. Acacia Catechu (the wood of this tree being especially suit-able for the sacrificial post). —यूप-द्रुम, अस्, m. = यूप-द्रु above; = रक्त-खदिर. —यूप-ध्वज, अस्, m. ‘having the sacrificial post as an emblem,’ epithet of the sacrifice (personified). —यू-प-लक्षण, अम्, n., N. of a Pariśiṣṭa of Kātyā-yana. —यूप-लक्ष्य, अस्, m. a bird (said to be so called as ‘having a post [round which a snare is tied] for its aim’). —यूप-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a sacrificial post. —यूप-वाह, अस्, m., Ved. the carrier or bearer of the sacrificial post. —यूप-व्रस्क, अस्, m. the cutter of the sacrificial post. —यूपाक्ष (°प-अक्°), अस्, m., N. of a Rākṣasa, (also read यूपाख्य।) —यूपाग्र (°प-अग्°), अम्, n. the top of the sacrificial post. —यूपाहुति (°प-आह्°), इस्, f. an offering at the erection of the sacri-ficial post. —यूपोच्छ्रय (°प-उच्°), अस्, m. the ceremony of erecting the sacrificial post.
यूपीय: यूपीय or यूप्य, अस्, आ, अम्, fit or suitable for a sacrificial post.
यूयम्: यूयम् यूयम्। See युष्मद्, p. 820, col. 3.
यूयुवि: यूयुवि यूयुवि, इस्, इस्, इ (fr. rt. 1. यु; ac-cording to the Pada-pāṭha युयुवि), Ved. setting aside, removing.
यूष्: यूष् यूष् [cf. rt. जूष्], cl. 1. P. यूषति, &c., to injure, hurt, wound; to kill; [cf. Slav. juchŭ.]
यूष: यूष यूष, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to be con-nected with rt. यूष् above; cf. जूष), soup, broth, pease-soup, the water in which pulse of various kinds has been boiled; (अस्), m. the Indian mulberry tree; [cf. probably Gr. ζωμός, ζύθος; Lat. jus; Slav. jucha.]
यूषन्: यूषन्, a form optionally substituted for यूष in all the cases except Nom. Voc. sing. du. pl., Acc. sing. du. (e. g. Acc. pl. यूषान् or यूष्णः, Inst. sing. यूषेण or यूष्णा, du. यूषाभ्याम् or यू-षभ्याम्, &c.).
येन: येन येन, ind. (inst. of 3. य or यद्), by which, by means of which, by which way, in which manner, in whatever way or manner, in which direc-tion, whither, where, in whatever direction, where-soever; on which account, in consequence of which, wherefore; because, since, as; that, so that, in order that (with pot. or pres. or fut.).
येमन: येमन येमन, अम्, n. = जेमन, eating.
येयजामह: येयजामह येयजामह, अस्, m. a term for the expression ये यजामहे, which immediately precedes the Yājyā or formula of consecration.
येयायेय: येयायेय येयायेय (°य-अय्°), अम्, n. (fr. rt. 1. या), that which is to be gone after and not to be gone after.
येवाष: येवाष येवाष, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a noxious insect, (also read यवाष।)
येष्: येष् येष्, cl. 1. P. येषति, &c., Ved. to boil up, bubble; to flow, leak; cl. 1. A. येषते, &c., to exert one's self, endeavour, perse-vere, = rt. पेष्, q. v.
येषत्: येषत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, boiling up, bubbling; flow-ing, leaking; (Sāy. on Ṛg-veda III. 53, 22 = स्र-वत्।)
येष्टिह: येष्टिह येष्टिह, Ved. epithet of a Muhūrta.
येष्ठ: येष्ठ येष्ठ, अस्, आ, अम् (superl. fr. rt. 1. या), going very quickly, moving with the greatest rapidity, (Sāy. Ṛg-veda VII. 56, 6 = यातृतम, अतिशयेन गन्तृ, but Ṛg-veda V. 41, 3 = यन्तृतम, re-straining greatly, as if fr. rt. यम्।)
योक्: योक् योक्, ind. = ज्योक्, for a long time.
योगक: योगक, अस्, m., N. of Agni (as the nuptial fire).
योगस्: योगस्, अस्, n. meditation, religious abstraction; the half of a lunar month.
योगाय: योगाय, Nom. A. योगायते, &c., to become Yoga, to be changed into religious contemplation or devotion.
योगि: योगि = योगिन् (occasionally occurring in ep. where the metre requires योगीनाम् for योगिनाम्).
योगित: योगित, अस्, आ, अम्, bewitched, enchanted, under the influence of charms or sorcery, mad, crazy, wild.
योगिन्: योगिन्, ई, इनी, इ, who or what joins or effects junction, being in conjunction with (at the end of a comp., e. g. चन्द्र-योगिन्, being in conjunction with the moon; cf. सोम-य्°); connected with, endowed or provided with, possessed of, relating to (at the end of a comp., e. g. काल-य्°, connected with fate; cf. स्वादु-य्°); possessed of magical powers; practising or following the Yoga philo-sophy; (ई), m. a follower of the Yoga system, a Yogin or contemplative saint, a devotee, ascetic in general; a religious or devout man, a magician, conjurer, one supposed to have obtained supernatural powers; N. of Yājñavalkya; of Arjuna; of Viṣṇu; of Śiva; of a Buddha; of a particular mixed caste; (इनी), f. a female demon or being endowed with magical power, a fairy, witch, sorceress (represented as an attendant of Śiva or Durgā; eight Yoginīs are enumerated as created by and attendant on Durgā); epithet of a particular Tantrika Śakti; (with Buddhists) a woman representing any goddess who is the object of adoration; N. of Durgā. —योगि-ता, f. or योगि-त्व, अम्, n. the being connected with, the having reference or relation to (at the end of a comp.), connection, relationship, the state or condition of a Yogin. —योगि-दण्ड, अस्, m. a kind of reed or cane (= वेत्र). —योगि-निद्रा, f. ‘a Yogin's sleep,’ light sleep, wakefulness. —योगिनी-जाल-शम्बर, अम्, n. and योगिनी-ज्ञानार्णव (°न-अर्°), अस्, m. and योगिनी-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of three Tantra works. —योगिनी-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town. —योगिनी-भैरव and योगिनी-हृदय, अम्, n., N. of two Tantra works. —योगि-पत्नी, f. a Yogin's wife. —योगि-मातृ, ता, m. a Yogin's mother. —यो-गि-राज्, ट्, m. a king among Yogins. —योगीन्द्र (°गि-इन्°) or योगीश (°गि-ईश), अस्, m. a chief or lord among contemplative saints; N. of Yājñavalkya. —योगीश्वर (°गि-ईश्°), अस्, m. = योगीश; (ई), f., N. of a goddess.
योगीय: योगीय (fr. योग), Nom. A. योगीयते, &c., to regard as Yoga, treat as Yoga.
योग्य: योग्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. योग and fr. rt. 1. युज्), fit for the yoke (Ved.); belonging to a particular remedy (Ved.); useful, serviceable, fit, becoming, suitable, proper, appropriate, fit for, qualified for, capable of, able to (with dat., loc. or even gen. or at the end of a comp. or with active or passive inf., e. g. स तत्-साधनाय योग्यः, he is fit for accomplishing that; नेयं वनस्य योग्या, she is not fit for a forest; कर्म-योग्य, fit for work; इमे योग्या राक्षसैर् योद्धुम्, they are able to fight with the Rākṣasas; छेत्तुं योग्यं तत्, that is fit to be cut); fit for Yoga, proper for reli-gious meditation; (अस्), m. a calculator of expedients; the asterism Puṣya; (आ), f. preparation, contrivance (Ved. Sāy. Ṛg-veda III. 6, 6, ‘materials or appliance for harnessing’); exercise, practice, (especially) bodily exercise, gymnastics, warlike or martial exercise, drill; N. of the wife of Sūrya; (अम्), n. a species of plant (= ऋद्धि); sandal-wood; a vehicle, con-veyance, carriage; a cake; milk. —योग्य-ता, f. or योग्य-त्व, अम्, n. suitableness, propriety, fitness, consistency, appropriateness; ability, capability. —योग्यता-वाद, अस्, m., N. of certain verses by an unknown author. —योग्या-रथ, अस्, m. a car-riage employed in military exercises.
योजक: योजक, अस्, इका, अम्, uniting, joining; one who yokes or harnesses, a harnesser, groom; an arranger, preparer, contriver, effecter; [cf. युद्ध-य्°।]
योजनिक: योजनिक, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of an adj. comp. after a numeral) so many Yojanas long, mea-suring so many Yojanas.
योजनीय: योजनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be joined or united; to be applied; to be added; to be made use of or employed, serviceable, useful; to be connected with (with inst.); to be set to work; to be grammati-cally connected or arranged.
योजन्य: योजन्य at the end of an adj. comp., e. g. षष्टि-य्°, sixty Yojanas distant.
योजयितव्य: योजयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus. of rt. 1. युज्), to be joined or applied; to be used or employed; to be chosen or selected; to be endowed or furnished with (with inst.).
योजयितृ: योजयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ (fr. the Caus.), who or what joins or unites; joining, combining, one who applies or sets, a setter (of precious stones), one who enchases, &c.
योजित: योजित, अस्, आ, अम्, joined, united, mixed; applied, arranged, concerted.
योजितृ: योजितृ, ता, त्री, तृ (fr. rt. 1. युज्), one who unites or joins, a joiner, uniter, connecter.
योज्य: योज्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. युज्), to be joined; to be applied or directed to; to be appointed or arranged; to be made use of or employed, to be brought in use; to be added to (with loc.); to be endowed or furnished with (with inst.); to be shared in; one on whom the mind is to be fixed or concen-trated, an object of Yoga.
योटक: योटक योटक, अस्, m. a combination of stars, &c., constellation.
योतु: योतु योतु, उस्, m. (probably fr. rt. 2. यु), = परि-माण, measure in general; cleaning; puri-fying, separating (?fr. rt. 1. यु).
योत्र: योत्र योत्र, अम्, n. (fr. rt. 2. यु), = योक्त्र, a fastening, tie, band, cord, rope, line; the tie or cord that fastens the yoke of the plough to the neck of the ox. —योत्र-प्रमाद, अस्, m., N. of a work.
योनि: योनि योनि, इस्, m. f. (rarely fem. in the older language; sometimes also योनी, f.; said to be fr. rt. 2. यु), the womb, uterus, matrix, vulva, vagina, female organs of generation; site of birth or production, any place of birth or origin, native place; a home, abode, site, lair, nest; birth, origin, source [cf. जगद्-य्°, कर्म-य्°], spring, fountain, (at the end of an adj. comp. = ‘originating in,’ ‘arising or proceeding from,’ ‘sprung from,’ ‘produced by,’ e. g. अगुरु-योनिर् धूपः, aromatic vapour proceeding from aloe wood); a repository, receptacle, seat; a mine; family, race, stock, caste, the form of exist-ence or station fixed by birth, a class or particular nature of created existence (e. g. that of a man, Brāhman, animal, &c.); the regent of the Nakṣatra Pūrva-phalgunī; water; a mystical term for the sound ए. —योनि-कुण्ड, अम्, n., N. of a particular mystical diagram. —योनि-गुण, अस्, m. the property of a womb, quality of a place of origin. —योनि-ग्रन्थ, अस्, m. = छन्दस्, q. v. —योनि-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, born or produced from the womb, viviparous, (opposed to अ-य्°, q. v.) —योनि-तस्, ind. from birth, by blood. —योनि-त्व, अम्, n. the being an origin or source; the arising from or being based on. —योनि-देवता, f. the Nakṣatra Pūrva-phalgunī. —योनि-देश, अस्, m. the region of the womb or the generative organs. —योनि-द्वार, अम्, n. the orifice of the womb; N. of a sacred bathing-place. —योनि-नासा, f. the upper part of the female organ, the point of union of the labiæ. —योनि-भ्रंश, अस्, m. fall of the womb, prolapsus uteri. —योनि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. connected with the womb or with the mother. —योनि-मुक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. released from birth or from being born again. —योनि-मुख, अम्, n. the orifice of the uterus. —योनि-मुद्रा, f., N. of a particular position of the fingers. —योनि-रञ्जन, अम्, n. the menstrual excretion. —योनि-रोग, अस्, m. disease of the female organs of generation. —योनि-लिङ्ग, अम्, n. the clitoris. —योनि-संवृत्ति, इस्, f. contraction or closure of the vagina. —योनि-सङ्कर, अस्, m. ‘confusion of births,’ mixture of caste by unlawful intermarriage, misalliance. —योनि-सम्बन्ध, अस्, m. relation by marriage, affinity. —योनि-सम्भव, अस्, आ, अम्, = योनि-ज. —योन्य्-अर्शस्, अस्, n. a fleshy excrescence in the female organ (= कन्द), pro-lapsus uteri (?) .
योनिन्: योनिन्, ई, इनी, इ, = योनि, at the end of an adj. comp.
योन्य: योन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. forming a womb or receptacle (for the waters; Sāy. = उदक-निर्ग-मन-द्वार).
योषणा: योषणा योषणा, f. (probably fr. rt. 2. यु, cf. युवन्; according to others connected with rt. 1. जुष्), a girl, maiden, young woman, wife; (ac-cording to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda V. 52, 14) a hymn, praise.
योषन्: योषन्, अणस्, f. pl. (apparently only used in plur.), Ved. women, young women, maidens; epi-thet of the ten fingers (in Ṛg-veda IX 1, 7, &c.).
योषा: योषा, f. a girl, young woman, woman, female, wife; epithet of the early dawn (Ved., but according to Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 123, 9. योषा = मिश्रयन्ती, blending); the female of an animal, a mare (Ved.); speech, (Sāy. = माध्यमिका वाक्।)
योषित्: योषित्, त्, f. a woman, female, wife; the female (of an animal, e. g. अलि-योषित्, a female bee). —योषित्-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, done by a woman, contracted by a female. —योषित्-प्रतियातना, f. the image or statue of a woman. —योषित्-सर्प, अस्, m. a serpent of a woman, a woman like a ser-pent. —योषिद्-रत्न, अम्, n. a jewel of a woman, a most excellent woman. —योषिन्-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, formed like a woman, representing a woman.
योषिता: योषिता, f. a woman, female, wife.
योषित्वा: योषित्वा, ind. (said to be a kind of ind. part. derived fr. योषित्), having made into a woman.
योस्: योस् योस्, ind. welfare, happiness, (gene-rally used in Ved. after शम्; according to Sāy. योः = यावनम्, ‘the warding off of dangers,’ as if fr. rt. 1. यु, or सुखस्य मिश्रयिता, ‘the mixer or causer of happiness,’ as if fr. rt. 2. यु।)
योहुल: योहुल योहुल, अस्, m. a proper N.
यौकरीय: यौकरीय यौकरीय (fr. यूकर), see Gaṇa Kṛśāśvādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80.
यौक्तस्रुच: यौक्तस्रुच युक्तस्रुच, अम्, n. (fr. युक्त + स्रुच्), N. of a Sāman.
यौक्ताश्व: यौक्ताश्व, अम्, n. (fr. युक्ताश्व), N. of a Sāman.
यौक्ताश्वाद्य: यौक्ताश्वाद्य and यौक्ताश्वोत्तर, अम्, n., N. of two Sāmans.
यौक्तिक: यौक्तिक यौक्तिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. युक्ति), any-thing which connects or binds, suitable, proper, fit; founded on reasoning, logical; inferrible, deducible; usual, customary; (अस्), m. a king's companion or associate (= नर्म-सचिव).
यौग: यौग यौग, अस्, m. (fr. योग), a follower of the Yoga system of philosophy.
यौगक: यौगक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to the religious exercise called Yoga; [cf. यौगिक।]
यौगन्धर: यौगन्धर or यौगन्धरक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. युगन्-धर), relating to Yugan-dhara.
यौगन्धरायण: यौगन्धरायण, अस्, m. (fr. युगन्-धर and योगन्-धर), a patronymic; N. of a minister of Udayana.
यौगन्धरायणीय: यौगन्धरायणीय, अस्, ई, अम्, relating or belonging to Yaugandharāyaṇa.
यौगन्धरि: यौगन्धरि, इस्, m. a king of the Yugan-dharas.
यौगपद्य: यौगपद्य, अम्, n. (fr. युग-पद्), simulta-neousness, contemporaneousness; यौगपद्येन = युग-पद्, simultaneously, together.
यौगवरत्र: यौगवरत्र, अम्, n. = युग-वरत्राणां स-मूह, see Gaṇa Khaṇḍikādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 45.
यौगिक: यौगिक, अस्, ई, अम्, useful, applicable; proper, customary, usual; belonging to a remedy, remedial; derivative, suiting the derivation, agreeing with the etymology, derived from the etymology, (यौगिकी सञ्ज्ञा, a word retaining that signification which belongs to it according to its etymology; यौगिक-रूढ, a word which has both an etymological and special meaning, cf. योग-रूढ); relating to the Yoga, proceeding or derived from the Yoga.
यौजनशतिक: यौजनशतिक यौजनशतिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. योजन + शत), one who goes a hundred Yojanas; one who deserves to be approached from a distance of a hundred Yojanas; [cf. क्रौशशतिक।]
यौजनिक: यौजनिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. योजन), going or extending a Yojana.
यौट्: यौट् यौट् or यौड्, cl. 1. P. यौटति, यौडति, &c., Caus. Aor. अयुयौटत्, &c., to join or fasten together; [cf. योटक।]
यौतक: यौतक यौतक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 1. युतक), anything which rightfully belongs to or is the pro-perty of any one; (अम्), n. private property, (espe-cially) property given at marriage, a woman's dowry, nuptial gift, presents made to a bride at her marriage by her father or friends; (according to some also) a gift to the bridegroom.
यौतकि: यौतकि, इस्, m. a patronymic; यौतक्या, f., see Gaṇa Krauḍy-ādi to Pāṇ. IV. 1, 80.
यौतव: यौतव यौतव, अम्, n. measure in general (= पौतव, q. v.).
यौथिक: यौथिक यौथिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. यूथ), be-longing to a band or troop, belonging to a flock or herd; (अस्), m. one belonging to the same flock or company, a companion, comrade.
यौथ्य: यौथ्य, see Gaṇa Saṅkāśādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80.
यौध: यौध यौध, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. योध), warlike, martial.
यौधाजय: यौधाजय, अम्, n., N. of various Sāmans.
यौधिक: यौधिक, epithet of a particular mode of fighting (Hari-vaṃśa 15980; also read योधिक).
यौधिष्ठिर: यौधिष्ठिर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. युधि-ष्ठिर), relating or belonging to Yudhi-ṣṭhira; (अस्), m. a descendant of Yudhi-ṣṭhira; (ई), f. a female de-scendant of Yudhi-ṣṭhira.
यौधिष्ठिरि: यौधिष्ठिरि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Yudhi-ṣṭhira.
यौधेय: यौधेय, अस्, m. a king of the Yaudheyas; N. of a son of Yudhi-ṣṭhira; = योद्धृ, a warrior; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a warlike race.
यौन: यौन 1. यौन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. योनि), relating to the womb or place of birth, uterine; concerning or relating to marriage or to affinity; resulting through marriage; connected by the mother's side, connubial; (अम्), n. matrimonial connection, con-jugal alliance, marriage, relationship by marriage; (at the end of an adj. comp.) proceeding from, arising from (e. g. अग्नि-यौन, proceeding from fire). —यौन-सम्बन्ध, अस्, m. relationship by marriage, affinity.
यौन 2. यौन, आस्, m. pl., N. of a people, (probably contracted for Yavana.)
यौप: यौप यौप, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. यूप), relating to the sacrificial post.
यौप्य: यौप्य, see Gaṇa Saṅkāśādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80.
यौयुधानि: यौयुधानि यौयुधानि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Yuyudhāna.
यौवत: यौवत यौवत, अम्, n. (fr. युवति), a num-ber of girls, assemblage of young women; = यौ-तव।
यौवतेय: यौवतेय, अस्, m. the son of a young woman.
यौवन: यौवन यौवन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. युवन्), ju-venile; (अम्), n. youth, youthfulness, the prime of life, bloom of youth, puberty, manhood, (at the end of an adj. comp. the fem. ends in आ, cf. प्राप्त-य्°); a number of young people (especially of young women); any youthful act or juvenile indiscretion; N. of the third grade or degree in the mysteries of the Śāktas. —यौवन-कण्टक, अस्, अम्, m. n. an eruption common in youth, pimples &c. on the face of young people. —यौवन-दर्प, अस्, m. the pride of youth, rashness, juvenile indiscretion or conceit. —यौवन-दशा, f. the period of youth. —यौवन-पिडका, f. = यौवन-कण्टक। —यौवन-प्रान्त, अस्, अम्, m. n. the extreme verge or end of youth. —यौवन-भिन्न-शैशव, अस्, आ, अम्, whose childhood is divided by youth, passing from childhood to manhood. —यौवन-मत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, intoxicated by (the pride of) youth; (आ), f. a species of metre, four times ¯˘˘¯¯, ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯˘˘¯¯. —यौवन-लक्षण, अम्, n. a sign or characteristic of youth; charm, loveli-ness, grace; the female breast. —यौवन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing youth, being in youth, young, youthful. —यौवन-श्री, ईस्, f. the beauty of youth-fulness. —यौवन-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘being in the bloom of youth,’ arrived at puberty, youthful, mar-riageable. —यौवनावस्था (°न-अव्°), f. the state of youth, youthfulness, puberty. —यौवनोद्भेद (°न-उद्°), अस्, m. the ardour of youthful passion, sexual love or inclination; Kāma-deva, the god of love.
यौवनाश्व: यौवनाश्व, अस्, m. (fr. युवनाश्व), a patro-nymic of Māndhātṛ; a patronymic of a grandson of Māndhātṛ.
यौवनाश्वक: यौवनाश्वक, अस्, or यौवनाश्वि, इस्, m. a patronymic of Māndhātṛ.
यौवराजिक: यौवराजिक, अस्, आ or ई, अम् (fr. युव-राज), see Gaṇa Kāśyādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 116.
यौवराज्य: यौवराज्य, अम्, n. (fr. युव-राज), the rank or office of a Yuva-rāja or heir-apparent associated in the kingdom; the rights and privileges of heir-apparent, right of succession to the kingdom.
यौषिण्य: यौषिण्य यौषिण्य, अम्, n. womanhood; [cf. योषन्।]
यौष्माक: यौष्माक यौष्माक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. युष्म), your, yours, belonging to you.
यौष्माकीण: यौष्माकीण, अस्, ई, अम्, your, yours.
